jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sample Control & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Alpha Analytical Laboratories**

Alpha Analytical Laboratories, Inc. is a full-service environmental testing laboratory network. We’ve served California since 1975 and run six ELAP-accredited labs across the state. We analyze waters, sediments and solids for drinking water systems, wastewater operations, industrial clients and environmental consultants. We also test for agencies that enforce permits, including the EPA, the State Water Resources Control Board, and county and city agencies.

Our Southern California lab in Signal Hill is growing. We’re looking for an organized, dependable team member to run sample control and support client project coordination.

**Sample Control**

* Receive incoming samples, review chains of custody (COCs), and inspect sample condition
* Log samples into our laboratory information management system (LIMS), assign work orders, print and attach labels, and prepare bench sheets
* Organize and store samples for laboratory processing
* Tell project managers or clients right away about errors, omissions or unclear testing requests on COCs
* Set up new client accounts in LIMS
* Pack and prepare samples for transfer to our other labs by GLS and FedEx
* Be the main point of contact for walk-in clients

**Project Coordination**

* Assemble sampling kits for clients and for field staff and couriers
* Maintain the field staff and courier schedule
* Track and restock bottles and sampling supplies (bottles, pH strips, coolers, etc.)

**What We’re Looking For**

* High school diploma (minimum requirement; BS preferred)
* Experience in data entry, a science background, or lab experience is preferred but not required. We’ll train the right person.
* Extremely strong attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Clear, professional communication with clients and coworkers
* Very comfortable with computers and Microsoft Outlook; Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) experience preferred
* Able to lift up to 50 lbs

**Benefits**

* PPO health insurance (eligible after 90 days)
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 12 months)
* Paid time off

**Schedule**

* Monday to Friday
* 8-hour day shift

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $23.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator- 11-231- SC/ The Way In
jobs.description:
Mission Statement  
The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian church. Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God. Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator (Scattered Sites) is responsible for all operational aspects of The Salvation Army-The Way In Youth Shelter scattered sites including management, programmatic, regulatory and fiscal compliance. The Program Coordinator provides professional, compassionate and safe care for all Transitional Aged Youth (TAY) program participants. The Program Coordinator will manage and supervise relationships with vendors, contractors and collaborators in coordination with program staff, Program Manager, and Director of The Way In.

Essential Functions

* Provide program coordination and individualized case management, advocacy, and referral services to transitional-aged youth (TAY) ages 18-24
* General monitoring of clients to ensure that a safe, quiet and friendly atmosphere is maintained in the in-home support
* Always maintain residential confidentiality and report any outside safety concerns (gang activity, neighbors, etc.)
* Ensure CES system coordination with community partners, collaborators, and regional partners.
* General monitoring of client’s needs to ensure a safe, welcoming, and accepting environment.
* Assist individuals in obtaining proof of housing readiness documents (ID, SSN, Birth Certificate, or VOD)
* Support individuals in developing foundational independent living skills, accessing mainstream benefits, securing employment, developing savings, and securing permanent housing.
* Regularly and accurately maintain participant data in HMIS and paper file, including complete documentation of all activities, services, and outcomes achieved.
* Maintain participant data in HMIS and paper file with complete documentation of all activities, services, and outcomes achieved.
* Log and gather necessary signatures for direct services provided to clients and report live updates to funder.
* Provide referrals to link participants to supportive services like mental health services, wellbeing providers, and other referral services as needed.
* Monitor and maintain documentation data quality with confidentiality, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Monitor TSA rental properties for public safety and cleanliness per Department of Public Health standards.
* Immediately report any pending upkeep, hazards, damage or concerns about TSA rental properties
* Maintain positive coordination and manage property relations with landlords on behalf of TSA.
* Document and report unusual occurrences, emergency incidents and injuries immediately to supervisor on-duty.
* Follow all program rules and TSA policies and procedures.
* Respond on-call and appropriately to emergency situations.
* Perform other duties as assigned by Director.

Working Conditions

Ability to walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis. Ability to grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead. Ability to operate computer, fax and telephone. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree with one year experience in related field (experience may be substituted in some circumstances)
* Experience working with transitional aged youth experiencing homelessness preferred
* Must be TB cleared prior to employment
* CPR and First Aid Certification
* Must have Class C Driver License
* Ability to drive and and pass a MVR
* Must have personal transportation as position requires local travel

Skills, Knowledge, & Abilities

* Driving Test, clean MVR.
* Ability to carry out assignments independently
* Computer literate in Microsoft Office Applications
* Knowledge of Homeless services resources in the community
* Knowledge of HMIS preferred
* Strong interpersonal skills with both clients and staff in a professional and respectful manner.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: ECOMMERCE COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Ecommerce Coordinator runs the day-to-day execution behind the L’AGENCE website: product setup, catalog accuracy, inventory visibility, and content readiness across ecommerce channels. The role works closely with the Senior Merchandiser, marketing, CRM, and operations.

**Examples of Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage product import and maintenance, including specifications, updates, and imagery coordination.
* Set up and maintain seasonal product catalogs, including attributes, imagery, pricing, and categorization, so each launch is accurate and on time.
* Maintain the master product attribute list across internal and external systems.
* Run daily QA checks on product accuracy, availability, and site presentation, and escalate issues.
* Execute onsite merchandising updates, such as collection and category sequencing, badges, and homepage modules, as directed by the Senior Digital Merchandiser.
* Partner with the Senior Merchandiser and operations on inventory tracking, preorders, markdowns, and campaign readiness.
* Support the website and email content calendar, ensuring timely delivery of assets and product accuracy.
* Organize and prepare content for digital campaigns for seamless execution.
* Provide data entry, reporting, and competitor and site benchmarking support to ecommerce, marketing, and CRM teams.
* Assist in approving product reviews and share insights with internal partners.
* Partner with CRM and Digital Marketing leaders on campaign processes as needed.

*The preceding functions have been provided as examples of the types of work performed by employees assigned to this job classification. Management reserves the right to add, modify, change or rescind the work assignments of different position and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job.*

**Skills/Competencies & Qualifications:**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in ecommerce, merchandising, or catalog management, ideally in fashion or apparel.
* High attention to detail and strong organization across multiple deadlines.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with comfort in product data and basic reporting.
* Familiarity with an ecommerce platform such as Shopify and a product information system.
* Clear written communication and a collaborative approach.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, merchandising, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Physical Requirements:**

* This position is an office position that requires frequent use of a computer, mouse and keyboard.
* Frequent sitting.
* Occasional standing, bending, stooping.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally.

*Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.*

jobs.title: Studio Operations & Client Relations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Oxygen Yoga & Fitness, we are a fast-paced, high-energy boutique fitness studio specialized in Far Infrared Hot Yoga and intense fitness classes. We pride ourselves on delivering a personalized, elite experience for our members. We do not just sell memberships; we build a strong fitness community.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are NOT looking for a passive receptionist who just wants to sit at a desk, check a box, and get free classes. We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented operator to manage our front desk, client relationships, and retention systems.

If you are a critical thinker who loves diving into customer management software, reading client history to solve problems, and building authentic relationships, this role is for you.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Proactive Client Management:** Manage daily outbound and inbound client communications through Mindbody and Axle CRM.
* **Personalized Problem Solving:** Review deep client message history and billing files to fully understand a member's context before responding. (Strictly no mindless, generic copy-pasting).
* **Membership Consultation:** Identify and recommend tailored membership options, class packages, and upsells based on the unique needs of our clients.
* **Studio Operations:** Seamlessly handle check-ins, process client payments accurately, audit account histories, and maintain an organized, spotless studio environment.
* **Class & Perk Accountability:** Represent the brand professionally. Studio perks (including free classes) are a reward for operational excellence, high energy, and reliable performance.

**Key Requirements**

* **Extreme Attention to Detail:** double-check your work, remember client details, and never leave a message request unaddressed.
* **Tech-Savvy & Resourceful:** Experience with or a strong ability to quickly master complex CRM software (Mindbody, Axle CRM, or similar platforms). You know how to use help centers to problem-solve software issues independently.
* **Active Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication. You write with empathy, accuracy, and clear intent; not just templates.
* **Hospitality or Service Mindset:** Background in high-volume administration is highly preferred.

**This Job is NOT For You If:**

* You are just looking for a quiet place to do homework or look at your phone.
* You struggle to navigate digital dashboards or audit billing histories.
* You handle client inquiries by sending quick, preformatted sales scripts without looking at their past account history.

**How to Apply**

To show us that you actually read this description and possess the attention to detail required for this role, please submit your resume and include the phrase "Infrared Proactive" at the very top of your application message. Applications without this phrase will be automatically disqualified.

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* A client messages the studio saying: 'I need to change my membership because my schedule changed, what are my options?' Walk me through the exact steps you would take and the details you are looking for before you type out your reply to them.

Experience:

* Sales administration: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (As-Needed)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Only the first 50 qualified applications will be accepted for further consideration.**

  
  

Plans, organizes and coordinates activities for a wide variety of events at outdoor sites and venues throughout the City, including Santa Monica Beach, Pier and the Annenberg Community Beach House. Communicates event requirements to division lead staff, venue staff and other City departments.

  
  

**NOTE:** **The eligibility list that will be established from this recruitment will be used to fill any Event Coordinator (As-Needed) vacancies that occur throughout the City during the life of the list. This is a temporary position without benefits.**

**Representative Duties**
-------------------------

Plans and independently coordinates the most complex events within the Division, including events which require extensive client contact, span over multiple days and locations and require heavy administrative details.

  
  

Responds to client and patron inquiries and assists potential clients in achieving their desired event goals. Conducts tours for prospective clients.

  
  

Assumes responsibility for booking events, reserving facility space and requesting contract preparation.

  
  

Assists in the development and implementation of marketing and sales strategies to generate leads and support future prospects for City venues.

Prepares and composes a variety of written materials including proposals, permits, invoices, reports, scaled diagrams, event billing and cost estimates, and other documents pertinent to venue services.

  
  

Obtains, documents and communicates event requirements, including technical, physical set up, parking, insurance, electrical, telephone and labor needs to operations staff.

  
  

Serves as liaison between the venue, client and patrons, and ensures compliance with terms of the contract, City policies and procedures City, County and State, fire and health regulations and safety codes.

  
  

Remains accessible during assigned events, responding to and resolving event problems or complaints from clients and patrons, maintaining a high level of customer service.

Conducts research, studies and surveys and makes policy and procedure recommendations.

  
  

Exercises technical and/or functional supervision over venue services assistants and operations staff.

  
  

Coordinates and documents the delivery of equipment to City departments.

  
  

Oversees and coordinates venue communications including website, event calendar, newsletters, electronic signs, brochures and informational materials.

  
  

Performs other duties, as assigned.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Knowledge of:**

  
  

Principles and techniques used in planning and coordinating service requirements for a variety of exhibits and theatrical, educational, entertainment, sports and industrial events

Public safety, emergency principles, health and fire codes, and related federal, state and municipal laws and regulations governing public assembly facilities

Operation specific safe work practices and procedures and applicable Cal OSHA regulations

Basic public relations, diplomacy, conflict resolution and customer service skills. crowd control principles, security, concession service, parking and operation needs of events

Event bookkeeping and accounting principles and procedures of estimating event costs

Principles and procedures of event layout and floor space planning

Event scheduling and booking principles and procedures

  
  

**Ability to:**

  
  

Communicate effectively both orally and in writing

Write effective reports, business correspondence and financial summaries

Effectively present information and respond to questions from clients, patrons, City staff and the public

Provide effective customer service

Creatively foresee, analyze, and resolve problems in a timely manner

Anticipate, schedule and coordinate equipment, operations, and service needs for a variety of events

Read and interpret blueprints and floor plans with a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral diagram, or schedule form

Calculate figures and amounts such as proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume

Function independently and as a member of a team, often under pressure.

Monitor the quality of service provided to clients and make recommendations regarding improvements in order to retain and attract clients

Work within tight, frequently changing, multiple deadlines

Ensure staff are compliant with all safety regulations and procedures

Maintain accurate, accessible correspondence and financial records

Effectively use a Window-based computer system, using Word and Excel

Establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships with City employees, officials, contractors, outside agencies and the general public

Work with persons from diverse social, cultural, and economic backgrounds as well as a variety of work styles, personalities, and approaches

  
  

**Skill in:**

  
  

Using a personal computer and applicable software applications

Working effectively with persons from diverse social, cultural and economic backgrounds as well as a variety of work styles, personalities and approaches

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  
  

Option A

  
  

Education: Graduation from an accredited college or university with an associate’s degree in business or public administration, arts management, theatrical production, recreation administration or a closely related field.

  
  

Experience: Three years of recent, paid work experience assisting with and/or planning and coordinating events. Experience coordinating events in a public or private community-oriented assembly facility is desirable. Experience must have included heavy public contact. Additional relevant work experience may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for-year basis.

  
  

Option B

  
  

Education: Graduation from high school or the equivalent.

jobs.title: Revenue and Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Breakaway Group is a next-generation live entertainment and media company creating experiences, content, and cultural moments that connect brands with highly engaged audiences. Anchored by one of North America’s largest independent touring music festival platforms, Breakaway Group has expanded into a broader entertainment ecosystem spanning live events, concerts, experiential marketing, content, media, and production.

Our portfolio includes:

* **Breakaway Live** - Our flagship touring music festival platform, bringing premium two-day EDM/Pop experiences to markets across North America.
* **Breakaway Presents** - Concerts, one-off events, and live entertainment experiences beyond the core festival platform.
* **Breakaway 360** - Breakaway Group’s experiential and brand activation business, developing custom experiences that connect brands with consumers in culture.
* **Breakaway Media / Studios** - Breakaway’s content, media, and production capabilities, extending partnerships beyond the live event and creating year-round opportunities for brands to engage our audience.

Together, these businesses give partners the opportunity to activate across live experiences, experiential, content, media, and culture through a single Breakaway Group relationship.

**THE ROLE**

The **Revenue and Partnerships Coordinator** is a high-ownership role at the center of Breakaway’s commercial organization. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this person will support revenue-generating initiatives across the company, coordinate the day-to-day operations of the Brand Partnerships team, and help advance strategic projects that span multiple departments.

This role combines sales coordination, partnership development, project management, executive support, and business operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized, commercially minded, comfortable initiating new relationships, and energized by turning ideas and opportunities into clear plans and completed work.

 **Requirements**

**RESPONSIBLITLIES:**

### **Brand Partnerships and Business Development**

* Serve as the central point of coordination for the Brand Partnerships team, ensuring leads are routed appropriately and team members have the information and support needed to move opportunities forward.
* Help prepare for prospect meetings by developing background research, briefing materials, agendas, and relevant partnership concepts.
* Coordinate follow-ups, internal assignments, deadlines, and supporting materials across the partnership development process.
* Drive targeted outbound prospecting and cold outreach to prospective brand partners, agencies, and other commercial collaborators.
* Research and identify partnership opportunities aligned with Breakaway’s audience, events, content, app, and broader business objectives.
* Support the Director, Revenue Operations in maintaining an organized pipeline of prospects, active conversations, proposals, and next steps.
* Support partner onboarding and internal handoffs once opportunities are confirmed as needed.

### **Sales Proposals**

* Support the proposal development process from initial opportunity through final delivery, coordinating inputs across Brand Partnerships, Marketing, Activation, Studios, 360, and other teams.
* Collaborate with the Creative Brand Strategy Lead in providing the required information to deliver sales proposals, presentations, partnership packages, and supporting materials.
* Maintain proposal timelines, manage reviews and approvals, and ensure deliverables are accurate, polished, and submitted on time.
* Track proposal status, outstanding decisions, pricing inputs, and next steps.
* Maintain current sales materials, case studies, templates, inventory information, and other resources used by the commercial team.

### **Chief of Staff Coordination & Support**

* Serve as a trusted partner to the Chief of Staff, helping organize priorities across the commercial organization.
* Manage scheduling and calendar coordination for the Chief of Staff, including internal meetings, external partner conversations, and leadership commitments.
* Prepare agendas and materials in advance of key meetings and ensure decisions and action items are documented afterward.
* Own recurring departmental reporting for the Chief of Staff and leadership team, consolidating updates across commercial functions.
* Help prioritize incoming requests, coordinate follow-ups, and maintain visibility across concurrent projects.
* Handle sensitive business information with sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion.

### **Commercial Strategy and Cross Functional Projects**

* Support the Chief of Staff in advancing high-priority strategic initiatives across Breakaway’s commercial divisions.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects by defining workstreams, organizing stakeholders, documenting decisions, and driving action items through completion.
* Conduct research and analysis to help evaluate new partnerships, business concepts, commercial products, and growth opportunities.
* Build project plans, meeting materials, timelines, and status updates that keep complex initiatives organized and moving forward.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential.** We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

Rocketship school leadership teams each include a Principal and Assistant Principals focused on instruction, an Office Manager focused on student information and family engagement, and a school leader focused on all other operations aspects of running the school - what some might call an “AP of Operations,” though we at Rocketship call it a Business Operations Manager (BOM). The BOM reports directly to the Principal and manages a team of hourly Operations Specialists. As the Operations leader, the BOM is responsible for all aspects of student meals, recess, arrival, dismissal, physical space, and safety at their campus. Thus, the role requires not only the ability to manage “business” topics like logistics and compliance, but also a deep understanding of behavior management, culture-setting, and behavior management coaching. The BOM helps ensure the school has a consistent culture across spaces, keeps our students safe, and ultimately enables instructional staff to focus on teaching and learning. This means BOMs are multi-talented leaders who can build systems, own processes like procurement and facilities maintenance, and partner with all adults on campus to support our students. The BOM role is an excellent opportunity for operationally-minded teachers and school leaders who want to grow and develop through an operational school leadership position.

### **Essential Functions**

* The essential functions of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

**Schoolwide Systems & Culture**

* Own the logistics, staffing, and daily management of arrival, lunch, recess, dismissal and physical space at your campus; ensuring joy and safety exude in all systems!
* Coach Operations Specialists daily in behavior management techniques, through both “in-the-moment coaching” and planned 1:1s.
* Design and lead professional development for Operations Specialists focused on behavior management skill development.
* Manage the physical space of the building and all facilities-related needs, including scheduling/meeting vendors and handling after-hours facilities emergencies.
* Manage food service operations, including managing staff, serving as the main contact with meal vendor, ensuring compliance, conducting internal audits, and ensuring meal program financial health.

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.
* Benefits: Share the current company benefits summary with qualified candidates; do not promise benefits, paid time off, or retirement terms beyond the company’s actual plan documents.

Inside Sales Representative – Pharmaceuticals & Medical Supplies

We are looking for a **highly motivated, talented, and competitive Inside Sales Representative** who wants to build a substantial book of business and be rewarded directly for the results they produce.

This is not an order-taking position. We are looking for someone who is **hungry to win, comfortable prospecting for new business, persistent in developing new accounts, and motivated by uncapped earning potential.**

Our company sells **pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and medical supplies to wholesale distributors.** You will be responsible for developing your own customer base, building long-term relationships, and turning those relationships into repeat business.

What You'll Do

You will take ownership of your territory and customer base from prospecting through ongoing account management.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new B2B accounts
* Identifying purchasing decision-makers and developing relationships with them
* Selling pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors
* Learning customers' purchasing patterns, product needs, and supply challenges
* Following up consistently on quotes, opportunities, and potential orders
* Growing existing accounts through repeat business and additional product opportunities
* Maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers
* Managing your sales pipeline and staying organized with follow-ups
* Working closely with our purchasing and operations teams to identify opportunities and fulfill customer needs

As you establish a strong customer base, the position becomes increasingly relationship-driven, with more of your time focused on managing, retaining, and expanding the accounts you have developed.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort. Medical sales experience is a plus.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of shelter and housing for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. This position serves as the primary administrative point of contact for residents, clinical faculty, and leadership. At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Institute of European Studies (IES) at UC Berkeley is the leading research center on Europe in the Western United States, and among the top three such organizations in the nation. Through interdisciplinary scholarship, international collaborations, grant opportunities and community outreach, IES fosters a deeper understanding of Europe's past, present, and future.
  
  
**IES Mission:** Support innovative research and teaching on contemporary and historical Europe, the European Union, and transatlantic relations. Promote academic and cultural ties with European partners. Provide a community for students and faculty who share a European focus to their work. Foster dialogue between scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and the public.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Coordinator supports the organized research activities and programming agendas of the France Berkeley Fund (FBF) and the Institute of European Studies (IES) in consultation with the directors of both organizations. This position supports outreach, communications, program development, and fundraising. To further the mission of both programs, the Program Coordinator promotes and supports research by UCB faculty and visiting researchers via the France Berkeley Fund and the IES Global Exchange programs.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Plans and develops new programs and adjusts existing programs in a research and public education environment.
  
Actively participates with faculty directors (FBF and IES) in long-range strategic planning for research and public educational programs. The FBF, Austrian Studies, Ctr. of French Excellence, Visiting Scholar, and URAP programs.
  
Monitors and coordinates activities according to the terms of the funding agreements.
  
Participates in developing constituencies and promoting programs to target audiences.
  
Identifies and develops evaluation tools for programs.
  
Under general supervision, assists in implementing specific activities for specific fundraising programs and activities.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Working skills to produce and deliver programs.
  
Good reading, verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and good presentation skills.
  
Reading knowledge of basic French.
  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
  
Continuing education in related field required.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of departmental and organization policies and procedures and/or the ability to learn; knowledge of educational program content and objectives.
  
Working knowledge of delivering public educational programs.
  
Working knowledge of current public education programs and trends.
  
Working knowledge of conducting needs assessment.
  
Good analytical skills to understand how business needs can be addressed through the design and delivery of training programs.
  
Additional European Languages a plus.
  
  
Salary & Benefits
  
  
For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.
  
  
Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.
  
  
The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $30.17 - $38.31.

*Review the full job description* *here**.*

**Youth Leadership Institute (yli)** brings together young people and their adult allies to create positive community change that promotes social justice and racial equity. With community-based programs based in Fresno, San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, Merced, Long Beach and the Eastern Coachella Valley, yli engages young people of color, low-income youth, and other impacted youth as advocates of social change.

**yli CORE VALUES**

* **Inclusion**: Young people are profoundly impacted by policies affecting their communities. yli brings youth to the table and works to institutionalize youth voice in the decision-making process.
* **Innovation**: Youth can often see a way forward where adults cannot. yli encourages youth to identify and implement their own solutions to the issues their communities face.
* **Social Justice**: Throughout history, young people have ignited and led social justice movements to create a better world for everyone. yli helps them to focus their attention on the root causes of injustice, and sharpen the skills they need to tackle them.
* **Community**: Nobody can do it alone! Through relationship and coalition-building, yli feeds the connective tissue within our communities to power our movements with the brilliance, resourcefulness, and wisdom of our partners.

  

We are looking for a **Program Coordinator (PC)** in **Marin County.** The PC will work in partnership with youth (ages 12 – 24) to organize, empower and mobilize youth and their communities to win real improvements for Marin County young people.

The PC will train and support youth leaders to develop and deepen political consciousness, assess and understand issues impacting their health and well being, build relationships and partnerships with other youth and community supporters, and drive countywide and local community campaigns that create long- term systems and/or policy change, and build power for future victories.

This individual is responsible for managing all of the logistics and functional tasks necessary for meeting the goals and objectives of the assigned programs, and for ensuring that the young people are experiencing high-quality and culturally relevant leadership opportunities.

The PC will implement up to 3 school-based Friday Night Live programs (FNL). FNL is an evidence-based youth development framework to aid in the reduction of youth substance use, as well as implementing our Social Emotional Learning track through FNL. The PC will work directly in partnership with a variety of youth cohorts and adult allies to lead work that supports and leverages local efforts to amplify youth voices and create sustainable social justice change.

**If you’re a good fit for this position, we encourage you to apply. Send us your resume and cover letter on our** **website****.**

We are looking for candidates with:

* Commitment to yli’s values of community, inclusion, innovation, and social justice
* B.A. and/or a minimum 2-3 years relevant experience in field of youth development
* Commitment to social justice, public health, and community organizing as strategies to affect change
* Experience with social media and media relations
* Demonstrated capacity to work with youth and adults from communities of color and low-income communities
* Able to work some evenings and weekends
* Access to a personal vehicle and clean driving record, with the ability to transport youth

  

This position requires in-person work in the Marin County office or in the community 4 days per week, with the option to work remotely on the 5th day.

This is a full-time non-exempt position with a rate of $27.77/hr - $30.54/hr. Compensation includes yli’s generous benefits package:

* Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (free options available for all staff, and yli pays 50% of dependent premiums)
* Paid time off (~50 days per year with Wellness Leave, Vacation/PTO, holidays, breaks, and your birthday holiday combined)

* 403(b) retirement plan with 4% match after one year of service

  

**To apply, submit your cover letter and resume on our** **website****.**

**NO RECRUITERS**

This position manages the end-to-end process of order fulfillment, from initial order placement to delivery. Responsible for analyzing customer purchase orders (POs), ensuring accuracy and alignment with company policies, and managing the end-to-end order process.

Supporting to customers, aiming to ensure their satisfaction and resolve any issues or concerns. Interacting with customers through various channels.

In this role, you will liaise with cross-functional internal teams Including Customer Service and Product Development and Manufacturing departments to improve the entire customer experience. This position may require occasional travel.

**Responsibilities**:

* Coordinating with various departments, ensuring accurate orders, managing inventory, and resolving any issues that may arise during the order fulfillment process.
* Track all milestones, including: order entry; engineer approval drawings; customer approval; order entry; bill of materials and drawings creation; buy-out or material availability; schedule; pre-erect or site-erect schedule; acceptance tests; shipping.
* Review and analyze POs for accuracy, material compatibility, and alignment with company standards.
* Communicate necessary changes or clarifications to customers in a professional, persuasive, and timely manner.
* Accurately enter orders into our ERP system and maintain compliance with quality standards.
* Collaborate with planning, production, purchasing, and finance teams to ensure orders are produced and shipped on time.
* Monitor and address order-related trends, suggesting business opportunities for blanket or scheduling agreements.
* Communicate with customers regarding changes to schedules and ensuring urgency.
* Supports Program Managers with customer interfaces as necessary on customer service related issues.
* Monitors and appropriately communicates risk on projects. Work with internal and external teams to develop strategies to mitigate risks.
* Develop and maintain a project plan and represent the company as needed for customer communications and meetings.
* Serve as the lead point of contact for all customer account management matters.
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.
* Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement as assigned.
* Forecast and track key account metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results, delivery, and quality objectives).
* Prepare reports on account status.
* Assist with challenging client requests or issue internal escalations as needed.
* Other duties as assigned by management.

Requirements:

* Minimum a Bachelor degree.
* + years experienced in Customer service management or equivalent.
* 2+ years experienced in Program management.
* Familiarity with the order lifecycle, from placement to fulfillment, is essential.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes and material properties.
* Understanding of ERP Business Information Systems like Epicor Proficiency in use of Microsoft Office suite of applications and CRM tools.
* Skilled in persuasive communication and effective collaboration.
* Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical skills with a focus on detail and accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in order management systems and CRM software.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Management
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management to join our NORAM Account Management team in New York. This is an opportunity to lead strategic relationships with some of the region’s most important merchants and help them get more value from their partnership with Checkout.com.

You will be a trusted business advisor and a senior point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise merchants. You will own the account strategy, build executive-level relationships, identify opportunities for growth, and coordinate the internal teams required to deliver an outstanding merchant experience.

This role is suited to a commercially minded account management leader who can operate with strategic perspective while staying close to execution. You will bring structure to complex work, influence stakeholders across the organization, and help merchants use payments as a lever for better customer experiences and business performance.

**How you’ll make an impact**
-----------------------------

* Own and execute account development plans for a portfolio of strategic NORAM merchants.
* Build high-touch, consultative relationships with merchant stakeholders from day-to-day operators through executive leadership.
* Serve as the primary commercial and relationship lead during the post-integration lifecycle, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and follow-through.
* Develop a deep understanding of each merchant’s business model, customer journeys, payment performance, priorities, and growth plans.
* Identify and advance opportunities across payment volumes, product adoption, geographic expansion, and broader commercial growth.
* Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and other relevant teams.
* Translate merchant needs into clear internal priorities and influence product roadmaps, go-to-market motions, and service improvements.
* Project-manage complex merchant initiatives, including cross-border expansion, new payment methods, optimization programs, and operational improvements.
* Use data and customer insights to diagnose performance, quantify opportunities, and make compelling recommendations.
* Provide regular account updates, risk visibility, and forward-looking plans to NORAM and global leadership.
* Share market feedback and best practices that improve how Checkout.com serves enterprise merchants across the region.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in B2B Account Management, Relationship Management, Customer Success, Strategic Partnerships, or a related commercial role, ideally in payments, fintech, technology, banking, or consulting.
* Experience managing complex enterprise accounts and building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders.
* Strong commercial judgment, including experience identifying growth opportunities and leading or supporting negotiations.
* A strategic, analytical, and data-driven approach to account planning and decision-making.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce, payments, fintech, and the competitive dynamics shaping the NORAM market.
* Clear and compelling communication skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally at all levels.
* Customer-first judgment and the ability to balance merchant outcomes, commercial performance, and operational realities.
* High ownership, organization, and follow-through, especially when priorities shift or information is incomplete.
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn complex products and apply new technologies, including AI, to improve account performance.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Commercial Lines Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Since 1998, Infinity Assurance Group, headquartered in Ladera Ranch, CA, has been serving as risk experts to clients of all industries domestically all over the United States, and internationally with access to over 200 carriers. We build long-term relationships by providing advice on a consultative basis, rather than commoditizing insurance. Generally speaking, one size does not fit all. Equally as important are the long-term relationships we maintain with our insurance markets/carriers. This allows us to achieve greater benefits for our clients than other insurance brokerage firms.

IAG is an atmosphere where everyone cares about each other and functions as a work family without bureaucracy, always supporting one another. We want our employees to grow with us and have opportunities to excel in their roles. We value not only our clients but our employees as well and want IAG to be a place where people want to work and spend their time. IAG is a place people are attracted to, not contracted by.

**Commercial Lines Account Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a highly organized and client-focused Commercial Lines Account Manager to serve as the primary day-to-day contact for our commercial insurance clients. In this role, you'll partner with Producers and Account Executives to deliver exceptional service and provide proactive guidance that helps clients protect their businesses and achieve their goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Client Relationship Management***

* Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned commercial insurance accounts.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through responsive, professional service.
* Respond promptly to client inquiries and requests, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
* Proactively identify coverage concerns, potential gaps, and service opportunities.
* Educate clients on coverages, policy provisions, and risk management solutions.
* Manage client expectations while delivering a high-touch service experience.

***Account Management & Service***

* Coordinate the onboarding and implementation of new commercial clients.
* Prepare applications, renewal submissions, proposals, and policy-related documentation.
* Review insurance policies, contracts, endorsements, certificates, and coverage requirements.
* Process policy changes, endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements, and terminations.
* Assist clients with billing inquiries, receivables, and policy administration matters.
* Report and monitor claims activity as needed.
* Maintain accurate and complete client records within the Agency Management System (AMS).

***Marketing & Carrier Relations***

* Market accounts to insurance carriers and wholesalers as appropriate.
* Obtain, compare, and analyze quotations from insurance markets.
* Develop comprehensive insurance proposals and coverage comparisons.
* Build productive relationships with carrier representatives.
* Stay informed of carrier products, underwriting guidelines, and market trends.
* Attend carrier training sessions, webinars, and industry events to maintain technical expertise.

***Operational Excellence***

* Prioritize and manage multiple client accounts, projects, and deadlines effectively.
* Maintain accurate electronic files and documentation in accordance with agency procedures.
* Utilize agency technology platforms, including Applied Epic, carrier portals, and other insurance software.
* Adhere to regulatory requirements, agency policies, and industry compliance standards.
* Support team members and provide backup coverage when needed.
* Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Active Property & Casualty license in the state(s) in which business is conducted required
* Industry designations such as CISR, CIC, CRM, or CPCU are a plus
* Minimum of 5 years of Commercial Lines Account Management experience in an insurance agency or brokerage environment
* Experience managing middle-market commercial accounts preferred
* Strong knowledge of commercial insurance coverages, carrier markets, policy servicing, and renewals
* Experience using the Applied Epic Agency Management System is required
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
* Excellent communication, client service, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and collaborative with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Ability to pass a criminal background check, as permitted by law

**Hours:** Monday – Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm

**Office Location:** 315 Lennon Lane, Walnut Creek, CA 94598 (Massie & Beck)

**Work Options:** This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule for candidates who reside within a commutable distance of the office.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive Compensation: $90,000-110,000 (based on expertise and experience)
* Health Insurance Plans (PPO, HSA, Copay Options)
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Company Paid Disability Insurance
* Supplemental Insurance including Critical Illness, Accident, Legal, Pet Insurance
* 401(k) with Safe Harbor Match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

**No Solicitation Notification to Agencies:** Please note that Keystone and our Partner Agencies do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Keystone will not consider or approve payment to any third parties for hires made.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
==================

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
==================

**Own and grow your book**
--------------------------

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

**Find and close expansion with Customer Success**
--------------------------------------------------

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

**Show up in person and go beyond your champion**
-------------------------------------------------

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

**Run a clean commercial process**
----------------------------------

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* 3+ years in a quota-carrying account management role, or an AE role with expansion ownership, at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of growing mid-market or enterprise accounts ($50K+ ARR), with expansion numbers you can name.
* Moderate technical understanding: you can explain how a team writes, reviews, and publishes docs (Git, Markdown, APIs, CI/CD), hold your own with engineering leaders, and know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer.
* Strong discovery and negotiation skills, including renewals, multi-year terms, and working with procurement.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, with clear ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Organized and data-driven: disciplined in Salesforce, accurate in forecasting, and able to read usage data to time an expansion.
* Willing to travel about one week a month.
* Able to work from our San Francisco office when you're not traveling.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've sold developer tools, API platforms, or other products bought by engineering teams.
* Experience with usage-based pricing, such as credits or overages.
* You've used Mintlify or another docs platform.
* Familiarity with AI products (AI search, assistants, MCP) and how teams adopt them.
* Early-stage startup experience, especially helping build an account management or expansion motion.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You know your book (every account's contract, renewal date, usage, and key contacts), you've met your CSM partners and top customers, and you have a plan for each account.
* **90 days:** Every renewal in the next two quarters has a plan and a next step, you've made your first on-site visits, and your qualified expansion pipeline is growing.
* **6 months:** You're closing expansion every month, renewals land on time without surprises, and your forecast is reliable.
* **12 months:** You've hit your expansion number, your book grows net revenue year over year, and at least one play you built is used across the team.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $150K - $250K
