jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Consulting & Research Agencies
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. That makes consulting both one of our biggest direct markets and a powerful route to the world’s largest enterprises.

This is a **senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales**. You’ll carry **full commercial ownership of a small number of global firms**—expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal—and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You’ll go deep in a handful of firms, build relationships from engagement managers to practice leaders to firm leadership, and turn project-by-project usage into firm-wide agreements.

You’ll do it with an account team around you—Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team—and in close partnership with our Partnerships team where firms bring Outset to their clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of a small number of **global consulting and professional services firms**, with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Carry and exceed an **aggressive seven-figure growth target** across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each firm: every practice, industry group, region, and research function; partner-level relationships; whitespace and spend; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Convert **engagement-by-engagement usage into firm-wide and multi-year agreements**, including enterprise licenses, preferred-vendor status, and global MSAs.
* Multi-thread relentlessly—from consultants and engagement managers to partners, practice leaders, and firm leadership—building relationships durable enough to survive partner turnover and reorgs.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors) across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that tie Outset to firm outcomes—faster engagements, higher-margin delivery, and differentiated client offerings—and convert them into committed budget.
* Negotiate and close complex agreements—global MSAs, multi-region commitments, procurement, security, and client-data confidentiality reviews—in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of consulting firms back into Outset—informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion.
* Regularly meet in person with partner leads across practices to create deep relationships with those driving business performance and who are responsible for partner-level results delivery, as well as operational leaders in centralized roles.

**Qualifications**

* **10+ years in enterprise sales**, including **5+ years in a named global or strategic account role** owning a small book of major accounts.
* **Demonstrated experience and expertise selling into and growing accounts at global consulting, market research and professional services firms**—strategy firms, the Big Three, the largest global market research agencies or large digital and technology consultancies.
* Deep understanding of how consulting firms buy: **partner-led decisions, practice and regional budgets, engagement-funded spend**, and central procurement.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts*—expansion, cross-sell, and renewal—not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management, with accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with partners and firm leadership, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority.
* Experience with complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor—a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup that is still building the playbook.
* Travel regularly to customer sites will be necessary to achieve your goals, and should be part of your prior playbook. Travel to our San Francisco HQ will also be required periodically.
* Bonus: prior consulting experience, or experience selling research, insights,

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Strategic - West
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

We're hiring an Enterprise Customer Account Manager who will own relationships with some of our most strategic customers. You'll guide them through every stage of their journey – from adoption to expansion - driving measurable business impact and long-term success. This role blends strategy, execution, and relationship depth: you'll act as the captain for your accounts, orchestrating internal and customer teams, solving challenges, and ensuring every customer achieves tangible outcomes with HackerRank.

We're seeking candidates based in a major metro area with convenient access to a major airport. Preferred locations include the **San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, Los Angeles, and Seattle**.

Candidates based in the **San Francisco Bay Area or New York City are required to follow a hybrid schedule**. Candidates based in Los Angeles or Seattle may work remotely.

#### **What you'll do**

* Maintain full functional and process knowledge of HackerRank products and services as well as market awareness and knowledge of competitive threats.
* Own and manage your Book of Business (BoB) - driving adoption, retention, and expansion across enterprise customers through deep partnership and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and execute account strategies that connect customer objectives with HackerRank's mission, ensuring long-term value realization and growth.
* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and technical leaders, embedding HackerRank into their hiring and workforce planning.
* Act as the captain for your accounts – leading internal and customer teams, resolving blockers, and accelerating time-to-value.
* Run proactive engagement cadences including QBRs, success check-ins, and executive reviews.
* Structure mutually beneficial commercial terms that promote long-term growth and customer success, balancing value realization with business expansion.
* Maintain accurate forecasts, health metrics, and growth pipelines while ensuring seamless handoffs and transparent reporting.

#### **Who you are**

* Bring 5+ years of Saas enterprise account management, ideally in fast-scaling environments.
* Known for your grit and curiosity, you stay resilient through challenges while constantly seeking to understand your customers' goals, industry shifts, and opportunities to create value.
* Naturally relationship-oriented, you build trust and credibility with Fortune 500 customers, becoming a long-term advisor who drives both strategic and measurable outcomes.
* A strong communicator and collaborator, you simplify complex ideas, engage confidently across audiences, and bring your customer and internal teams together around shared goals.
* Deeply expert in your craft, you combine product mastery with a keen sense of business impact, connecting HackerRank's platform to customer value.
* Highly organized and outcome-driven, you manage multiple enterprise accounts with precision – balancing structure, transparency, and consistent delivery.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Experience working with HR tech or developer ecosystems, especially within enterprise-scale organizations.
* A background in driving multi-product adoption or leading high-growth, customer-centric initiatives.
* Comfort navigating cross-functional complexity to align internal teams and deliver unified customer outcomes.

#### **You will thrive in this role if**

* You act like a captain, owning outcomes end-to-end and thriving in fast-moving, high-accountability environments.
* Building long-term partnerships energizes you more than short-term wins.
* You balance empathy with execution - understanding customer pain points while driving tangible business results.

PolicyLift is the AI-native growth engine for independent P&C agencies: one platform that drives growth, consolidates fragments of point solutions, so agencies can source and close premium faster. Our team brings experiences from top-tier technology companies like Google, Meta, and Insurtech leaders like Qualia.  
  
PolicyLift is VC-backed, used by 1,000+ agents and actively services a book of over $1B in premium.

**About the Role**
------------------

You’re a former independent P&C agent who has quoted, bound, serviced and renewed policies. Now you'll draw on that experience to help build and implement technology that helps agents win more premium.

PolicyLift services a book of over $1B in premium, and we're adding agencies faster every month. This role is the person who helps get new agencies live, keeps their team unstuck, and brings the agent's point of view into what our team builds next. It's a hybrid of three things: product, onboarding, and ongoing agency success.

Customers listen to you because you've done their job. Our engineers listen to you for the same reason. You provide deep industry experience to solve real pain points at independent agencies.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

PolicyLift does four jobs for independent P&C agencies:

* **Grow.** Website, SEO, AI search and email marketing that bring in leads.
* **Intake.** AI agents, smart forms, and carrier data and documents, so every lead is captured and complete.
* **Submit.** One-click transfer to the systems that matter: AMS, CRM, raters and carriers.
* **Bind.** Comparisons and proposals that get the policy bound.

Every one of those touches the details agents care about: which carrier for which risk, what an HO-5 covers that an HO-3 doesn’t, how a BOP submission differs from a package. Agencies trust us with that work. The person who onboards them, trains their CSRs, and brings their feedback to our roadmap should speak their language fluently.

**Support**

* Be the first call when an agency hits something insurance-specific: a quote that doesn't look right, a carrier question, a workflow the AI should handle differently.
* Reproduce, document and triage issues before escalating to engineering, then follow them through to resolution.
* Help drive adoption early (low usage, reverted workflows, a CSR who went back to the old way) and fix the root cause: retraining, a workflow change, or a product request.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **Fluent in personal and commercial lines.** You can explain HO-3 vs. HO-5, when an umbrella makes sense, BOP vs. package, GL class codes, experience mods and commercial auto symbols without looking them up.
* **Hands-on with agency tech.** You've lived inside an AMS, run comparative raters, worked carrier portals and download feeds.

Pure outbound: first point of contact for prospects, works curated target account lists, books meetings for the Head of GTM and senior sales team. The phone is the highest-converting channel, so the role requires enjoying cold calling. Strong performance leads to an AE or sales management path.

### **Responsibilities**

**Outbound Prospecting**

* Work curated target account lists (stadiums and sports venues, retail brands, hotels, airports, automotive, large events).
* Research event leaders, marketing executives, innovation leads, and operations decision-makers at each account.
* Run personalized multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
* Book qualified discovery meetings for the Head of GTM and senior AEs with clean handoff notes.

**Lead Enrichment and List Expansion**

* Add contacts at existing accounts (events leaders, CMOs, heads of fan/guest experience).
* Pull exhibitor and attendee lists from conferences (Google Cloud Next, NRF, HITEC, sports business conferences).
* Report which titles, verticals, and messaging convert.

**Pipeline Hygiene and CRM Discipline**

* Log every meaningful interaction in HubSpot; keep deal stages and lead statuses current; close lost after 4–5 unanswered follow-ups with a note.
* Maintain clean contact records, accurate next steps, visible task queues; update sequences and track reply rates.

**Event and Field Support**

* Attend trade shows and events to capture leads, scan badges, schedule on-site demos; follow up on event leads within 24 hours.

### **How to Approach the Work**

* Passion for outbound, especially cold calling; persistence (most enterprise deals close after the 6th–8th touch).
* Real-time CRM updates; proactive communication; ownership of weekly activity, conversion, and pipeline metrics.
* Balance manual list grinding with automated sequences/enrichment; bias toward action.

### **Requirements**

* 2–3 years of BDR/SDR experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, hardware, or enterprise sales.
* Demonstrated outbound experience (cold calling, cold emailing, building pipeline), not only inbound qualification.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding quota (meetings booked, opportunities created, pipeline generated).
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including with senior executives.
* Resilience and high energy; desire to grow toward AE or sales management.
* Curiosity about the product (holograms, AI, enterprise use cases).
* Tools: HubSpot (required; Salesforce acceptable); Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, Lusha, Clay; Outreach, Salesloft, Smartlead, Instantly; Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn, Loom; Google Sheets/Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP); Calendly, Chili Piper, HubSpot Meetings.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* AI tools for prospecting and personalization (Clay, ChatGPT, Claude, custom GPTs).
* List pulling via web scraping or basic automation.

### **Compensation and Growth**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on meetings booked and pipeline generated (no range listed).
* Equity; health, dental, and vision; direct mentorship from the Head of GTM and senior sales team; path to AE or sales management.
* Palo Alto office most days; some travel for trade shows and customer events.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Email career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Business Development Representative (BDR)", with a short note on why this role and why LiveX, your most impressive outbound metric with context, and your resume or LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. This is a key role for us as we expand, and you'll have the chance to be part of our growth journey from the ground up. As an BDR, you'll help fuel our pipeline, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the success of our Account Executives. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with us, with potential leadership opportunities, unlimited earning potential, and equity in the company.

About Aware Health

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. People with MSK conditions are often misdiagnosed and are treated passively with opioids, injections or surgery. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. Our platform gets people the right amount of help, avoiding inappropriate and unnecessary tests, drugs and surgeries. Our approach has resulted in positive outcomes for our members and has saved self-funded employers up to 59% annually in MSK costs.

About the Job

You'll be a key player in identifying, qualifying, and generating new business opportunities. Reporting to our SVP, Growth, you will be an integral part of our sales engine, contributing to the identification of potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting up meetings for our Account Executives. You'll be expected to drive top-of-funnel activity, helping to build relationships and create demand for our solution. We will invest in your growth, give you exposure to the full sales cycle with our SVP, Growth as a mentor, and ideally promote you into an AE role down the line.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment, is energized by sales challenges, and can adapt to changing needs. The right person will help us shape our outreach strategies, improve processes, and contribute to scaling our efforts. If you’re excited by early-stage growth and enjoy building something from the ground up, this is the role for you.

Metrics

Leading Indicators

* Leading Indicator: Activity
* Leading Indicator: Meetings booked per month
* Leading Indicator: Meeting to opportunity conversion rate

Outcomes:

* Number of sourced opportunities
* Closed/won revenue

Responsibilities

* Build our pipeline! Prospect and generate leads through cold calling, emails and social selling
* Be the first point of contact: Qualify inbound leads and set meetings for account executives
* Build and maintain relationships with innovative brokers, ecosystem partners and prospects
* Evangelize Aware Health’s value proposition, building demand for our solution
* Keep data updated in Hubspot CRM
* Strategically contribute to and drive the development of outreach strategies
* Collaborate with account executives to optimize conversion rate and sales pipeline
* Participate in the continuous improvement of the sales process (your voice matters to us!)
* Share insights about market trends and feedback from prospects to help refine our go to market strategy
* Partner with the Head of Growth to nurture and work deals from initial prospecting through close (we’re excited to train you up so you’ll be closing your own deals in this complicated industry over time!)

Why You’ll Love This Role

* Real-time access to executives who are invested in your growth
* A collaborative and fast-paced start up environment where your voice matters
* An impact-driven mission where you can feel great about the product you’re selling
* A clear career path to AE and beyond

Qualifications

* Experience in sales or lead generation, preferably in health tech, insurance, or a B2B sales environment
* Proven track record of meeting activity and lead-generation targets
* Excellent communication skills with a focus on relationship-building and consultative selling
* Self-starter with the ability to succeed with limited resources
* Familiarity with CRM systems, preferably Hubspot
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Personal qualities of persistence, grit, and adaptability

Compensation and Benefits

* Base salary $65-$75k with an OTE of $130k - $140k and uncapped earning potential
* Equity in the company
* Medical (PPO, HMO, HDHP), dental and vision
* FSA administration
* Life Insurance
* Short/long term disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Commuter benefits
* 401K

jobs.description:
Description:

Division: Development and Communications Department

Reports to: Director of Development and Communications

Work Location: Oakland Campus 675 23rd Street Oakland, CA 94612

Hours: Monday - Friday 8:30 a.m.- 5 p.m. (with occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays as required)

Status: Full-Time/Non-Exempt

Salary: $22-$24 per hour

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Development Assistant provides administrative, data management, and fundraising support to the Development and Communications Department at St. Vincent de Paul of Alameda County. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate donor records, processing gifts, preparing donor acknowledgments, coordinating fundraising campaigns, and supporting digital communications. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, dependable, and proactive, with proficiency in donor databases and digital communication tools and a commitment to serving neighbors in need with compassion and dignity.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Administrative Support**

* Provide administrative support, including preparing correspondence, reports, presentations, and other materials.
* Receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail; coordinate outgoing correspondence.
* Coordinate the receipt, documentation, delivery, and storage of in-kind donations.
* Assist with preparing furniture invoices for conferences.
* Maintain organized departmental files and records and support daily workflows, deadlines, and process improvements.

**Donor Database Management, Gift Processing, and Deposits**

* Maintain accurate donor records in the organization's CRM and fundraising database, including gift entry, donor information, and giving histories.
* Process and document donations promptly and accurately.
* Prepare donation deposits, enter deposit information into the CRM, and verify that gift and deposit records align.
* Reconcile gift records monthly with the Finance Department, investigate discrepancies, and support accurate financial reporting.
* Prepare and send gift acknowledgments, tax acknowledgment letters, receipts, and other donor correspondence promptly.
* Contact donors as needed to acknowledge gifts, verify information, and follow up on donations or missing details.
* Protect the confidentiality and integrity of donor records and financial information.
* Generate donor lists, database reports, and data summaries for fundraising activities and monthly reporting.
* Monitor data quality, correct record discrepancies, and improve database organization and processes.

**Fundraising and Campaign Support**

* Assist with planning, coordinating, and executing fundraising campaigns, direct mail appeals, special events, and other development initiatives.
* Prepare mailing lists, campaign materials, donor communications, and fundraising reports.
* Make updates to the organization's Wix website, including refreshing content, posting fundraising campaign information, and updating donation links as needed.
* Create, schedule, and distribute donor emails and fundraising appeals using Constant Contact.
* Maintain email contact lists and assist with audience segmentation, quality control, and tracking campaign performance.
* Support the preparation of written materials, reports, and organizational updates for donors and external stakeholders.
* Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to improving fundraising and administrative processes.

Requirements:

**General Qualifications**

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling donor data, gift records, deposits, and financial information.
* Strong organizational, time management, and administrative skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and fundraising databases; experience with Fundraiser or similar donor management software is preferred.
* Familiarity with Wix or similar website management platforms and Constant Contact or similar email marketing tools is preferred.
* Professional, courteous, and service-oriented communication skills when working with donors, volunteers, colleagues, and community members.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.
* Demonstrated reliability, accountability, initiative, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, follow instructions, accept supervision, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Positive, flexible, and solutions-oriented approach, with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Willingness and availability to work occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays to support fundraising events, campaigns, and organizational activities.

**Educational and Experience Requirements**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in business administration, Communications, Marketing, Nonprofit Management, or a related field; or relevant professional work experience in nonprofit development, fundraising, donor relations, database management, or administrative support.

**Mission and Organizational Commitment**

All employees of St. Vincent de Paul of Alameda County are expected to support the organization's mission of serving neighbors in need with compassion and dignity. Employees are expected to demonstrate professionalism, integrity, accountability, and a commitment to collaboration across departments.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may evolve with organizational needs, and employees may be assigned additional tasks by their supervisor or management.

We are committed to engaging multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower our clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!

* 1,100+ Team members
* 950+ Consultants
* 640+ Ph.D.s
* 90+ Disciplines

Our Opportunity:

Exponent is a leading engineering and scientific consulting firm whose multidisciplinary experts bring together deep technical knowledge, rigorous analysis, and clear communication to solve some of the most complex challenges facing businesses, insurers, law firms, and government agencies. This is a **full-time, in-office position**, requiring a strong on-site presence to support the daily operations of the Executive Office.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful, with the judgment and professionalism to manage sensitive matters with discretion and confidence. This individual understands how to anticipate needs, protect executive time, drive follow-through, and use modern tools—including AI-enabled technologies—to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and quality of support.

You will be responsible for:

* Manage complex calendars for the CEO, President, and other designated executives, including coordinating meetings with internal and external stakeholders and exercising strong judgment in prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, and protecting executive time

* Support special administrative projects for the CEO, President, General Counsel, Chief Human Resources Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and other members of the executive team, as needed
* Maintain detailed project documentation, including project plans, status reports, tracking spreadsheets, and other records using Microsoft Excel and related tools
* Coordinate and facilitate communications across multiple internal teams and departments, including helping triage urgent matters, approvals, requests for input, legal and compliance-related follow-up items, and general updates
* Support the General Counsel and legal team with litigation-related administrative coordination, including litigation holds, subpoena responses, claims reporting to insurance carriers, document collection and production logistics, information gathering, deadline tracking, and coordination with internal stakeholders and outside counsel
* Organize and support the day-to-day activities of the Executive Office, including handling sensitive executive and legal requests, managing logistics, and helping create a smooth and efficient operating environment
* Assist with expense reporting, travel approvals, filing systems, contact management, signature coordination, budget tracking and outside counsel invoices, and other administrative processes requiring accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment
* Use approved modern productivity tools, including AI-enabled technologies, to support document preparation, organize information, improve workflows, improve responsiveness, and improve the overall quality and efficiency of executive support, consistent with Exponent’s confidentiality, privilege, information security, and data handling requirements
* Assist with planning and coordination of professional and social events, offsites, and other executive activities, as needed
* Welcome visitors, candidates, and other guests to the Executive Office and help create a highly professional first impression for internal and external stakeholders
* Attend selected staff meetings or executive meetings, as appropriate, to document action items, support follow-through, and help maintain momentum on key priorities
*

jobs.title: Foster Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Foster Program Coordinator**

**Schedule:**

The working schedule for this position is Sunday - Thursday, 9:30AM - 6PM with Friday and Saturday day off.

**Who We Are**

ACC is one of the nation’s largest open-admission animal shelters, whose mission is to End Animal Homelessness in NYC. We touch the lives of nearly 20,000 animals each year. ACC is more than an animal shelter; we are a resource to the community, always seeking ways to keep the human-animal bond intact. With a 90% placement rate, our progressive, life-saving initiatives contribute to the successful placement of our animals.

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). We also help keep NYC communities safe and rescue animals in need, responding to emergencies that involve animals as well as keeping our doors open 24/7 for people and animals in need.

**Summary**

The Foster Program Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the day-to-day operations of the foster program. As a Foster Program Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating the movement of animals in and out of foster homes, providing support to a network of over 800 foster parents, and help facilitate the adoption process for every animal in foster care.

**Required Qualifications**:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* The ideal candidate should have a minimum of two-years work experience in a client facing position.
* Strong computer literacy required.
* Able to excel in a fast-paced, often high-stress, ever-changing environment.
* Treat animals and people with respect and employ humane handling techniques whenever possible.
* Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs.

**Benefits**

ACC values work/life balance and offers a generous paid-time-off (PTO) package that includes vacation time, birthdays off, personal days and sick pay. We also value physical and mental health by offering a great open access Cigna medical, dental and vision insurance at a low premium to our employees as well as 401K and Pension, Life Insurance. We also have on-the-job training for 2-4 weeks, periodic all staff trainings to include safety, DEI, cross training, and other growth opportunities.

Because ACC is a nonprofit, employees may be eligible for loan forgiveness, cancellation, and/or consolidation under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF). Created under the College Cost Reduction and Access Act of 2007, PSLF allows borrowers who work full time for nonprofits and government agencies to have their outstanding debt forgiven tax-free on Federal Direct Loans, after making 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying repayment plan.

Please use this link for more details on our benefits package.

**Essential Job Functions**:

* Provide support to foster volunteers to ensure all their needs are being met. This includes answering questions, providing support for behavioral issues, following up with medical concerns, and handling other issues that may arise.
* Coordinate transportation of foster animals to foster volunteers, between care centers, and to adoption events.
* Coordinate with Veterinary Services to ensure foster animals leave the care center with appropriate vaccines and treatment plans, schedule follow-up vet appointments, and assist with handling animals when appropriate.

**Other Responsibilities**:

* Assist in identifying appropriate foster animals for off-site adoption, outreach, and media opportunities.
* Coordinate logistics for foster animals attending events including scheduling behavior assessments, medical, and transport.
* Assist Foster Supervisor with management of foster volunteer database.
* Secure appropriate photographs of animals for foster and events.
* Recruit new foster volunteers through orientations, interviews, and training.
* Lead Open Foster Hours, identify appropriate foster animals to new fosters.
* Fear Free certification within 30 days of hire.
* Complete other duties as assigned by supervisor.

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Prior experience with Microsoft Office Suite preferred.
* Prior experience with animals (dogs/cats/rabbits), either paid or volunteer, is strongly preferred but not required.
* Bi-lingual (Spanish) preferred but not required.
* Customer-driven and focused on providing a positive, upbeat, experience for all clients.
* High attention to detail, strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive while working in busy environment.
* Work well independently but also function seamlessly as a member of a team.

**Work Environment:**

At ACC it's all hands-on deck. We work together as a team, which means you may be asked to help with tasks that involve working outside in all sorts of weather. As a busy animal shelter in one of the biggest cities in the world it can get noisy inside. Employees should have the ability to remain calm yet professional in stressful situations involving animals and/or members of the public. ACC houses hundreds of animals in its facilities at any given time and with that comes fur, odors and other airborne particles in abundance.

ACC offers many low-cost services to pets and people in need. This includes compassionate end-of-life services for people who cannot afford to go to a private veterinary office but still want to provide a professional and peaceful transition for their beloved pet.

Training will take place at our Manhattan Centers. Employees will report there until the Bronx location is fully operational.

**Reports To:** Foster Supervisor

**Overtime:** This is a non-union position and is eligible for overtime.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Consulting & Research Agencies
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. That makes consulting both one of our biggest direct markets and a powerful route to the world’s largest enterprises.

This is a **senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales**. You’ll carry **full commercial ownership of a small number of global firms**—expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal—and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You’ll go deep in a handful of firms, build relationships from engagement managers to practice leaders to firm leadership, and turn project-by-project usage into firm-wide agreements.

You’ll do it with an account team around you—Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team—and in close partnership with our Partnerships team where firms bring Outset to their clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of a small number of **global consulting and professional services firms**, with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Carry and exceed an **aggressive seven-figure growth target** across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each firm: every practice, industry group, region, and research function; partner-level relationships; whitespace and spend; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Convert **engagement-by-engagement usage into firm-wide and multi-year agreements**, including enterprise licenses, preferred-vendor status, and global MSAs.
* Multi-thread relentlessly—from consultants and engagement managers to partners, practice leaders, and firm leadership—building relationships durable enough to survive partner turnover and reorgs.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors) across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that tie Outset to firm outcomes—faster engagements, higher-margin delivery, and differentiated client offerings—and convert them into committed budget.
* Negotiate and close complex agreements—global MSAs, multi-region commitments, procurement, security, and client-data confidentiality reviews—in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of consulting firms back into Outset—informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion.
* Regularly meet in person with partner leads across practices to create deep relationships with those driving business performance and who are responsible for partner-level results delivery, as well as operational leaders in centralized roles.

**Qualifications**

* **10+ years in enterprise sales**, including **5+ years in a named global or strategic account role** owning a small book of major accounts.
* **Demonstrated experience and expertise selling into and growing accounts at global consulting, market research and professional services firms**—strategy firms, the Big Three, the largest global market research agencies or large digital and technology consultancies.
* Deep understanding of how consulting firms buy: **partner-led decisions, practice and regional budgets, engagement-funded spend**, and central procurement.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts*—expansion, cross-sell, and renewal—not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management, with accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with partners and firm leadership, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority.
* Experience with complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor—a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup that is still building the playbook.
* Travel regularly to customer sites will be necessary to achieve your goals, and should be part of your prior playbook. Travel to our San Francisco HQ will also be required periodically.
* Bonus: prior consulting experience, or experience selling research, insights,

---------------

AWS is seeking a sales professional to manage a global customer relationship with one of our large global Automotive & Manufacturing customers. You will define and execute a CXO relationship strategy within the account, including engaging with a dedicated account team, AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction.  
  
The Global Account Manager ("GAM") will partner with the customer to build strategic relationships, articulate a clear vision, and deliver business value. The successful GAM will develop and execute a broad strategy for earning customer trust and driving AWS solution and service adoption across the customer's Digital Technology, Operations, Line of Business (LoB), and Research & Development leadership. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Customer Solutions Managers, Industry Specialists, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service Teams and Professional Services) to deliver customer outcomes. This is an Individual Contributor role, but necessitates an account leader mindset, and may included dotted line responsibility for downstream sales, technical and industry specialist resources. The GAM will also effectively leverage existing programs and mechanisms, innovate and scale new mechanisms, and develop formal case studies and other forms of references highlighting outcomes and solutions running on AWS.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Contributing to, and leading, within an AWS customer account team.  
  
Identifying and building trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, specifically CxOs at the customer, across Line of Business (LoB), Functional (R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain), and Digital & IT.  
  
Working closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to support the best business solution(s) for customers.  
  
Defining a CXO relationship strategy within the customer, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction levels.  
  
Displaying strong leadership presence and being able to command a room in a meeting. Should be seen as an authority in communicating via email, phone, and face to face, and comfortable writing executive briefing documents for, and communicating with, the most senior executives at the company.  
  
Operating with significant autonomy and discretion. A high degree of decision making is required in routine customer engagement, business judgment is critical.  
  
Managing a global sales pipeline via Salesforce and facilitating all stages of a sale.  
  
Participating and leading in the negotiation and closing of legal agreements, such as Enterprise Agreements (EAs), and contracts, such as Private Pricing Addendums (PPAs).

**WHO WE ARE**

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry's largest proprietary databases and AI. You will collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Operations, Analytics, and Product to ensure campaigns launch flawlessly, perform against key metrics, and align with each client's attribution model and business objectives.

In this role, you will closely monitor performance data, lead performance reviews, and proactively identify optimizations that strengthen outcomes. * Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams.

* Experience with campaign management tools, ad platforms (DSP/SSP), or reporting systems a plus.

jobs.description:
**About PolicyLift**
--------------------

PolicyLift is the AI-native growth engine for independent P&C agencies: one platform that drives growth, consolidates fragments of point solutions, so agencies can source and close premium faster. Our team brings experiences from top-tier technology companies like Google, Meta, and Insurtech leaders like Qualia.  
  
PolicyLift is VC-backed, used by 1,000+ agents and actively services a book of over $1B in premium.

**About the Role**
------------------

You’re a former independent P&C agent who has quoted, bound, serviced and renewed policies. Now you'll draw on that experience to help build and implement technology that helps agents win more premium.

PolicyLift services a book of over $1B in premium, and we're adding agencies faster every month. This role is the person who helps get new agencies live, keeps their team unstuck, and brings the agent's point of view into what our team builds next. It's a hybrid of three things: product, onboarding, and ongoing agency success.

Customers listen to you because you've done their job. Our engineers listen to you for the same reason. You provide deep industry experience to solve real pain points at independent agencies.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

PolicyLift does four jobs for independent P&C agencies:

* **Grow.** Website, SEO, AI search and email marketing that bring in leads.
* **Intake.** AI agents, smart forms, and carrier data and documents, so every lead is captured and complete.
* **Submit.** One-click transfer to the systems that matter: AMS, CRM, raters and carriers.
* **Bind.** Comparisons and proposals that get the policy bound.

Every one of those touches the details agents care about: which carrier for which risk, what an HO-5 covers that an HO-3 doesn’t, how a BOP submission differs from a package. Agencies trust us with that work. The person who onboards them, trains their CSRs, and brings their feedback to our roadmap should speak their language fluently.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Insurance Workflow Expertise**

* Work directly with the leadership team on representing the independent agent, informing what we build, in what order, and what "done right" means for an agent.
* Turn real agency scenarios into the standard we build and measure against: the personal lines and commercial lines cases every release has to get right.
* Review new workflows, integrations, and automations before they ship, from the agent's seat.
* Stay up to date on key agency technology such as AMS, raters, intake tools, carrier portals and download feeds our customers depend on, and where PolicyLift fits in each.
* Participate in the industry by visiting agencies in person, attend conferences, and user groups as PolicyLift's most credible voice.

**Onboarding and Implementation**

* Help get new agencies live on PolicyLift.
* Learn how each agency handles intake, quoting, submissions, renewals and servicing, and configure PolicyLift to match.
* Map each agency's stack (AMS, raters, carriers, CSR handoffs) and wire PolicyLift into it.
* Train their team, from a two-person office to a 30-person agency rollout, and hand off a healthy account to our customer success lead.
* Build quick-reference guides, onboarding checklists, role-based training paths and adoption playbooks, and turn one agency's wins into resources every agency gets.

**Support**

* Be the first call when an agency hits something insurance-specific: a quote that doesn't look right, a carrier question, a workflow the AI should handle differently.
* Reproduce, document and triage issues before escalating to engineering, then follow them through to resolution.
* Help drive adoption early (low usage, reverted workflows, a CSR who went back to the old way) and fix the root cause: retraining, a workflow change, or a product request.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A former (or current) agent.** You hold or recently held a P&C license, and you've spent 3+ years in an independent agency as a producer, or account manager
* **Fluent in personal and commercial lines.** You can explain HO-3 vs. HO-5, when an umbrella makes sense, BOP vs. package, GL class codes, experience mods and commercial auto symbols without looking them up.
* **Hands-on with agency tech.** You've lived inside an AMS, run comparative raters, worked carrier portals and download feeds.
* **A process builder.** You see the whole process from lead to renewal, not just the next task, and you notice where it breaks before you get there.
* **Bilingual: insurance agent and product specialist.** You can earn an agency owner's trust in the morning and walk an engineer through an edge case in the afternoon.
* **Curious about AI.** You don't need to write code. You do need to want to understand how the product works and help it get better.

**Bonus qualifications**
------------------------

* You've owned or run an agency, managed a personal/commercial lines team of producers, or managed a service team.
* Designations such as CIC, CISR, CPCU or AINS.
* You've led an AMS or rater migration or implementation.
* You've tried AI tools in your agency and know where they fall short.
* Any product or tech-adjacent experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity
* Fully covered health, dental and vision (full-time only).
* A fast-track to promotion in Product, Customer Success, or Support
* A direct line to leadership: your feedback turns into real product insights
* Meaningful ownership and visibility across company outcomes and internal operations.
* A front-row seat at an early-stage AI company that respects what agents actually do.
* An opportunity to bring your insurance expertise into a leading AI platform for insurance.

**How we work**
---------------

We’re an early-stage company. We move incredibly fast, priorities shift, and every day brings a new opportunity to solve a problem. Transitioning from an agency

Since 2006, we've grown to around 4,400 employees in 22 countries, launched over 40 products, and serve over 299 million users and their visitors worldwide. At Wix, we push you to innovate and evolve in non-traditional ways. We operate in collaborative, high-performing teams, building cutting-edge products and leveraging AI to redefine how our users create, manage and grow their dreams online.

Although we're already industry leaders in web creation and business, our work is nowhere near done. Our goal is to become the main engine of the Internet so we can create a more open web for all.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a sharp, trend-obsessed Social Media Manager to manage the social presence of some of Wix's biggest brands, including Wix.com, Wix Studio and Symphony. You will own the strategy and the craft: planning what we say and where, then creating the short-form videos that bring it to life, for both organic and paid, from A to Z.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who lives on social, spots trends before they peak, and can take an idea from a first hook to a published video on their own.  
  
On your day to day you will:

* Establish social media strategies for various Wix products across short form video platforms - TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
* Build and manage content calendars, balancing always-on organic content with campaign, launch and product moments
* Create short-form video content from A to Z: concepting, scripting, shooting, editing, captioning and publishing, for both organic and paid use
* Develop platform-native content that fits the nuances of each channel and each brand's voice and audience
* Partner with the paid media team to produce, test and iterate on social ad creative, including hooks, formats and variations
* Monitor trends, memes, sounds and formats, and turn them into timely content that feels native and fresh
* Track performance across channels, report on results and use insights to optimize content, formats and posting strategy
* Use AI and automation tools to speed up ideation, production and editing, and experiment with new workflows

At Wix, we believe our best work happens together. Our work model is fully in person, with 3 days a week from our New York office.

 **Qualifications**

* 1-2 years of experience in social media, content creation or a similar role (agency, in-house at a tech/AI brand or personal brand experience all count)
* Proven ability to create short-form video end to end, with a portfolio or sample videos that show your work
* Hands-on editing skills with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar

* A fresh perspective on social and an intuitive grasp of trends, formats, creators and culture across TikTok, Instagram and beyond

* Understanding of content strategy and planning, including calendars, platform best practices and audience insights
* Familiarity with paid social creative and what makes an ad perform, or strong curiosity to learn fast
* Strong writing skills and a clear, clever tone of voice
* Analytical mindset: comfortable reading metrics and adapting based on performance
* Self-starter who ships consistently, takes initiative and thrives in a fast-moving environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent English (written and spoken)

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships & Licensing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About NYRR**

New York Road Runners (NYRR) was founded in 1958 when a small group of passionate runners vowed to bring running to the people and has grown from a local running club into the world’s premier community running organization. NYRR’s vision is to build healthier lives and stronger communities through the transformative power of running.

NYRR’s year-round offerings of races, community events, programs, and training resources provide hundreds of thousands of people with the motivation, know-how, and opportunities to start running and keep running for life. NYRR’s premier event, the famed TCS New York City Marathon, attracts the world’s top professional runners and committed amateurs alike, while also raising millions of dollars annually for charity and driving economic impact for New York City. NYRR is equally committed to the runners of tomorrow, passionately providing youth fitness programs that educate and inspire children in underserved communities in New York City, nationwide, and around the world.

Headquartered in New York City, NYRR is a 501(c)(3) organization. To learn more, please visit www.nyrr.org.

*At New York Road Runners, we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse workplace by finding the best candidate for the job. We understand that skills come from a variety of different backgrounds. Checking off every single requirement on our job description is not necessary to apply. If you think you are a good fit and have a passion for the work we do, please submit your application. We are eager to learn about your experience and skills! You may be the right candidate for this or other open positions.*

New York Road Runners is an Equal Opportunity Employer

**About the Department**

The Strategic Partnerships & Runner Products Department includes the Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team, the Runner Products and Services team, and the Professional Athlete Group.

The Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team secures and manages mission-aligned partnerships providing revenue, value-in-kind and strategic support for advancing NYRR's mission. The team collaborates across NYRR departments to maximize partnership value and runner engagement through strategic programming. Additionally, the department oversees licensing of NYRR IP rights, including production of co-branded product and apparel.

**About the Position**

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Partnerships and Licensing, the Coordinator will support corporate and licensee partner relations, race sponsorship execution, and seasonal department initiatives. The Coordinator will assist in all day-to-day operations of the department including licensing account coordination, executing partner deliverables, budget tracking, credentialing, race entry management and project recapping.

The Coordinator will work collaboratively with other departments in the organization and requires multi-tasking, good and decisive judgment, and a high level of professionalism. Key responsibilities are built upon the intersection of client strategy, NYRR brand strategy, and top-notch client service in a high-paced, fluid environment.

The position requires some work on evenings and weekends, to supervise partner-sponsored programs at the NYRR RUNCenter featuring the New Balance Run Hub, and NYRR races. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, has experience supporting sponsorships, live events or licensing and can multi-task across a variety of project responsibilities.

**Job Responsibilities (primary and secondary duties):**

* Support day-to-day partner and licensee relations, managing variety of administrative tasks including: status call scheduling and agendas; drafting of project plans, meeting notes and recaps; and budget tracking
* Represent team on conference calls and in meetings, demonstrating ability to effectively and professionally communicate updates, and ask and answer questions
* Communicate and collaborate effectively with colleagues and cross-functional departments to ensure sponsorship deal points are executed on time
* Attend partner events and sponsored races, supporting execution of partner assets and hospitality, and represent NYRR with partners
* Maintain records of logos, samples, photos, and inventory for licensing projects and support approval management
* Generate post-event recaps (e.g., capture web shots, samples, etc.) in a timely manner
* Process invoices and purchase orders
* Help coordinate internal meetings and events including catering, agendas, meeting materials
* Showcase effective decision-making, critical thinking and proactivity to meet deadlines
* Showcase creativity and innovation in problem solving when issues or opportunities arise
* Manage professional communication with partners and vendors
* Manage race related administrative tasks, including entries, gifting and credentials
* Provide general support to department for seasonal projects throughout the year
* Adapt to feedback and instruction and apply learning to projects

**Job Requirements:**

*Experience:*

* 1-2 years of work experience in licensing, marketing or sponsorships, such as with an agency, property or brand
* Proven experience in project management (planning, execution, and reporting)

*Education & Certifications:*

* Two or four-year degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or related field, or two years of related experience preferred

*Skills and Attributes:*

* Outstanding organizational skills including impeccable attention to detail, time management, and a strong sense of personal accountability
* Ability to work independently, using good judgement, resourcefulness and the ability to sustain productivity under pressure

* Sense of ownership, responsibility, and accountability

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Radar**

Radar is the global leader in geolocation, with geofencing SDKs, maps APIs, and AI-enabled solutions for marketing, fraud, and operations teams.

Why is Radar the best place to work?

* We're trusted by some of the world's best companies, from high-growth startups to the Fortune 500.
* We operate at incredible scale, processing over 1 billion API calls per day from hundreds of millions of devices.
* We've raised $85.5M from world-class investors, including Accel and Insight Partners.
* We have a high-performance culture with ambitious, entrepreneurial teammates in every role.
* We recently moved into a new office in Flatiron, Manhattan.
* We were named a top 10 best place to work in NYC by Crain's.

Despite our growth and scale, we're still just getting started. That's where you come in.

**About the role**

We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to help drive Radar's next stage of growth. You'll break into strategic enterprise accounts, build qualified pipeline, and create new opportunities as we scale Radar Protect, our fast-growing fraud prevention product.

This isn't your typical SDR role. You'll have real ownership from day one, partnering directly with Account Executives and sales leadership to develop outbound strategies, engage senior decision-makers, and help shape our go-to-market motion. We're looking for someone ambitious, resourceful, and excited to build a career in technical sales.

You'll report to our Senior Sales Development Manager and be based in our Flatiron (NYC) headquarters. We work from the office Monday through Thursday, with flexibility to work remotely on Fridays.

**What you'll do**

* Own outbound prospecting across calls, email, LinkedIn, and creative channels to generate qualified pipeline.
* Partner with Account Executives to build strategic account plans and break into enterprise accounts.
* Develop deep product knowledge to confidently engage technical buyers and communicate Radar's value.
* Test new messaging, identify market opportunities, and help refine our outbound playbook.

**Who you are**

* You have a bachelor's degree; prior SDR or BDR experience is a plus.
* You're a strong communicator who can confidently engage prospects and build relationships.
* You're curious about technical products and eager to understand how they solve real business problems.
* You're driven, resourceful, and organized, with a strong sense of ownership.
* You're coachable, adaptable, and ambitious, with a desire to grow in a high-performing sales team.

**Who you'll work with**

* Connor Rapp, Senior Sales Development Manager
* Zachary Fraser, Chief Financial Officer / Chief Operations Officer
* Radar's Account Executive team

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Meaningful stock options in a fast-growing company
* 401(k) plan with 4% match
* New HQ in Flatiron, NYC
* Top-notch equipment
* Catered lunches
* Unlimited PTO
* Health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% coverage for employees
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Commuter and fitness benefits

We'll share full details of our benefits package at the offer stage. Benefits may vary by location.

*Radar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

Compensation Range: $95K - $105K

jobs.description:
**Manufacturer’s Sales Representative / Outside Sales Representative**  
**New York Territory & New Business Development**

**This is an established-territory sales position with a strong new-business development component.**

Stonehenge US is looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative to manage and grow our established dealer network throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island and surrounding New York markets, while also developing new business and expanding our presence throughout the region.

This is a hybrid sales position combining **account management, territory growth, and new-business development**. The representative will be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with existing dealers, identifying opportunities to grow current accounts, prospecting new dealer locations, and helping expand Stonehenge US into untapped areas of the New York market.

Depending on the candidate’s experience and qualifications, the position may be structured as a dedicated outside-sales role or may include product and sample delivery responsibilities within the territory.

Our products include natural stone veneer, manufactured stone, thin brick, bluestone, limestone and step treads, porcelain pavers, artificial grass, outdoor living products, solar paver lights, iron doors, and other building and hardscape products.

**Compensation & Schedule**

* $70,000 base salary or more if include product and sample delivery responsibilities within the territory.
* Commission of approximately $12,000 for every $1 million in sales
* Monday through Friday
* Approximately 45 hours per week
* Full-time position
* Primarily field-based outside sales

**Company-Provided Vehicle & Equipment**

Stonehenge US provides the tools needed to operate effectively in the field, including:

* Company Ford F-150 or other company-provided vehicle depending on the position structure
* Company gas card
* Company E-ZPass
* Company cell phone
* Company iPad
* Product samples, catalogs, promotional materials, and other sales tools
* Company-paid normal business travel expenses

**Territory & Location**

Stonehenge US’s main warehouse and office is located in Staten Island, New York. This position will spend the majority of its time in the field managing and developing accounts throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, Staten Island, and surrounding New York markets.

Because of the territory, candidates located in or near Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, or surrounding areas would be well positioned for this role.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Managing and growing an established customer base throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, and surrounding New York markets
* Researching and identifying new masonry, hardscape, landscape-supply, building-material, lumber, and related dealers
* Scouting and developing new accounts throughout the New York market
* Cold calling and scheduling meetings with owners, purchasers, managers, and other decision-makers
* Visiting existing and prospective dealers and understanding their product mix, suppliers, inventory, and opportunities
* Identifying where Stonehenge US products can solve a problem or fill a product gap
* Developing relationships from the first introduction through the first order and continued account growth
* Presenting products, pricing, displays, samples, and dealer programs
* Creating and managing sales opportunities and follow-up
* Developing new accounts into consistent long-term customers
* Planning efficient daily routes and managing the territory independently
* Working closely with our Sales Manager and internal team on larger opportunities and account-development strategies
* Maintaining accurate notes, follow-ups, opportunities, and customer information within the company sales system
* Assisting with limited product or sample deliveries when required, depending on the structure of the position

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable both managing an established territory and developing new business.

The right person should be:

* Self-motivated
* Organized
* Persistent
* Comfortable cold calling and walking into new businesses
* Able to research and qualify prospects independently
* Comfortable speaking with owners, purchasers, managers, and other decision-makers
* Able to build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships
* Able to identify opportunities to grow existing accounts
* Able to plan productive routes and manage time efficiently
* Comfortable following opportunities from the first conversation through the sale
* Able to recognize when an opportunity is worth continuing to pursue and when it is time to move on
* Comfortable working independently while also following company sales processes and management direction

Experience in building materials, masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, stone, pavers, construction products, contractor sales, or related industries is strongly preferred, although we will consider candidates with strong outside B2B sales experience.

**About Stonehenge US**

Stonehenge US is a growing supplier and manufacturer of masonry, hardscape, and outdoor-living products serving building-material dealers throughout the Northeast.

We are continuing to expand our dealer network and are looking for someone who wants the opportunity to manage and grow an established territory, develop new dealer relationships, and grow their income as the territory expands.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid training

Experience:

* Sales : 1 year (Required)

License/Certification:

* drivers license? (Required)

Work Location: On the road

Leeding Builders Group (LBG) is a New York-based construction manager specializing in open shop commercial, residential and hospitality projects. Founded on a reputation of professionalism and quality, with the financial backing of AECOM, we are one of New York City's premier builders.

As a separately branded entity of the AECOM Construction Management group, LBG operates independently with its own management structures and resources.

* Organizes and carries out most assignments in accordance with standard practices, instructions, or previous training.
* Interact with Superintendents to address project questions/issues.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Alvarez & Marsal is seeking a dynamic, enthusiastic Executive Assistant (EA) to join its North American Data and AI team. This group is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. **This is a hybrid position based in our New York City office, with an in-office expectation of two days per week.**

Our EAs are made up of a team of experienced professionals who support our top executives and teams across the globe. These critical team members are viewed as strategic partners who enable our teams to deliver gold standard work to our clients. The candidate should be motivated, resourceful, organized, poised, and able to operate independently with strong attention to detail.

**How you will contribute**

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support to the North American Data and AI group Managing Directors in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
* Manage complex internal and client calendars, coordinating across multiple executives, clients, stakeholders, and time zones while navigating frequent changes and competing priorities.
* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, detailed itineraries, and last-minute changes.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including client meetings, leadership meetings, team meetings, off-sites, and one-on-one meetings, managing all associated logistics for both in-person and virtual settings.
* Process time and expense reports using Concur and provide ongoing administrative support to Managing Directors.
* Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, senior executives, and internal stakeholders, ensuring responsive and seamless communication.
* Train and support new hires as needed on administrative processes, systems, and team procedures.
* Perform Excel analysis as required, including event and vendor contract comparisons.
* Provide proactive support on special projects and evolving business needs, anticipating priorities and ensuring strong follow-through.
* Additional duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years Executive Assistant / Business Operations Experience
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Outstanding customer service / interpersonal skills; ability to support multiple executives / varied working styles.
* Strong relationship management skills, ability to build a personal network throughout the company as a trusted team member.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders and external partners.
* Ability to ensure communications are clear, thorough, and specific, with attention to follow-through and confidentiality.
* Excellent computer and calendaring skills to include a working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Salesforce, Concur, file sharing software (i.e., Box).
* Skillful execution of administrative activities, with high attention to detail, organization and process; consistently produce error-free work; Organized and detail orientated with excellent follow through; independent.
* Strong problem-solver.
* Self-motivated, tactful, and a great team player.
* Professional image and demeanor.
* Project coordination and management experience needed at an intermediate complexity.
* Proven ability to manage projects, work under pressure with minimal direction and consistently make deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to continuously acquire new competencies and accept new challenges.

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
