jobs.description:
**GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB**

Reporting directly to the General Services Director, this position supports developing, managing, and coordinating capital improvement projects, including planning, organizing, bidding and construction administration, and project execution. Monitors capital budgets to ensure project costs stay within the scope of work. Provides administrative support, project coordination, and financial oversight for all aspects of capital construction projects. Assist with preparing construction specifications, bid documents, contracts, and change orders. Enters approved payment applications into the city’s ERP system. Completes field inspection reports and inputs and updates data, documentation, and budget information into the CIP project management platform (Procore).

**SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Functions:

Coordinates and prepares facility services and construction specifications, and bid documents. Coordinates pre-bid and pre-construction conferences. Drafts Request for Proposals (RFP) and develop the scope of work.

Coordinates the design and permit process and work of contractors, engineers, architects, design professionals, and other personnel to ensure the efficient and economical use of program funds, personnel, materials, facilities, and time.

Monitors individual project budget summaries assuring expenditures are within approved budget, tracking changes to the contract documents that may result in change orders. Assists with project financial reports, accounting, and grant reimbursement. Prepares project budgets and assists with budget development, as requested by the director. Monitors and ensures all requirements of grants and contracts are met. Prepares complete reports on time with supporting conclusions and recommendations.

Develops and maintains data systems and records to track the progress of each project for proper evaluation, control, and documentation to ensure compliance with City, State, and Federal requirements.

Assures effective communication among consultants, contractors, department heads, and other stakeholders. Communicates project status to staff and other affected groups, keeping building occupants informed as to the progress of projects and of any developing problems, reporting alternative courses of action to mitigate such problems.

Creates presentation materials, authors' written and oral reports, and media materials. Uses speaking engagements, media interviews, and other methods to enhance the community’s awareness of and appreciation for capital projects and to educate community stakeholders regarding each project’s function and objectives.

Coordinates design, specification, and construction meetings.

Performs other related work as required by the director.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND TRAINING**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, architecture, construction management, construction administration, or a related field, supplemented by three (3) years of experience with project coordination, business operations, or administrative management.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience which provides the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities for this job will also be considered.

Requires a valid state driver’s license with an acceptable driving history.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS REQUIRED**

Physical Requirements:

This position classifies the physical exertion requirements has the ability to exert very moderate physical effort in light work, typically involving some combination of stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, and which may involve some lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 30 pounds). Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discriminate colors or shades of colors, sounds, odor, depth, and visual cues or signals. Some tasks require the ability to communicate orally. Performance of essential functions may require exposure to adverse environmental conditions, such as odors, fumes, temperature and noise extremes, machinery, vibrations, electric currents, traffic hazards, or bright/dim lights.

**Company Overview:** We have built our company one person at a time. We understand that our team members are the key to our success. Our superior results begin by hiring and training good people and continue by supporting and retaining them. We build cohesive teams and promote opportunities for growth, development and leadership.

  

**Summary**: The Sales Coordinator supports the sales team in attaining the monthly as well as annual targets and operates with management and clients to determine business requirements. A Sales Coordinator is instrumental in assuring focused and productive communication with the new and existing clients, external distributors, representatives and agents as well as internal team members. Additionally, the Sales Coordinator is responsible for the different kinds of administrative functions essential for everyday operation of the system and fulfillment of the company offers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**: include the following. Other duties may be assigned by a supervisor as needed.

* Self-starting personality with an even disposition to effectively communicate with guests, team members and community.
* Be familiar with and adhere to Legacy Ventures Service standards as outlined in the Blueprint and other policies / rules of conduct, to include personal appearance / grooming, attendance and safe / efficient operations.
* Respond in a professional and courteous manner to telephone inquiries regarding room only wedding blocks, e-event bookings, individual reservations and hotel information by providing accurate and timely information and service.

* Input group contracts, recaps, room lists, and reservations as they are received from the sales department. Process Commissions/Rebates/Brand Rewards.
* Manage sales marketing materials required for packaging, advertising, and promotion of company products and/or services (e.g., sales kits, trade-show supplies, VIP amenities, site inspections, etc.)
* Support sales team when traveling by communicating with them on an "as needed basis" and assist in managing logistics of business needs.
* Assist with special reservations to include V.I.P. reservations and packages. Support and communicate with Reservations regarding room requests.
* Ensure that all group reservations, rates and routing, and resumes are properly detailed and set up prior to the group arrival. Attend Resume Meetings.
* Conduct Site visits, guest room tours, property tours, special guest requests, Create files, handling of mail, faxes, etc.
* Maintain a professional appearance at all times and to conduct personal behavior in a mature professional manner when representing the hotel or company.
* Reserve and block small room’s only groups.
* Coordinate with various departments the activities related to booked business.
* Assist with the coordination and planning of special client events.
* Must be able to meet work schedule and attendance standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned

* Comply with attendance rules and be available to work on a regular basis.
* Provides for a safe work environment by following all safety and security procedures and rules.
* Perform any other job related duties as assigned.

**Qualification Requirements:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Must have a flexible schedule and ability to work days, evenings or nights any day of the week, including weekends and holidays.
* Must have exceptional customer service skills
* Demonstrated ability to perform multiple tasks in a busy environment and remain flexible
* Ability to work well in a team environment
* Must have a self-starting personality with an even disposition to effectively communicate with guests and staff.
* Possess excellent written, verbal, and organizational skills. Computer literacy and financial management a must.

**Education and/or Experience:** College degree preferred. High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Language Skills:** Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other associates of the organization.

**Mathematical Skills:** Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

**Reasoning Ability:** Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to ensure individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the associate is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; and talk or hear. The associate is occasionally required to walk and reach with hands and arms.

The associate must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
**As a Global Account Manager, a typical day might include the following:**

* Identifying and developing relationships with key customer influencers, stakeholders, and decision-makers to grow sales of SEL solutions.
* Developing and maintaining strategic account plans to execute customer-specific sales strategies and achieve business objectives.
* Understanding customer requirements and aligning SEL solutions to address their operational and strategic needs.
* Participating in the forecasting process through annual sales planning and periodic updates to strategic account plans.
* Serving as the primary point of contact for customers and building strong relationships with stakeholders and executive leadership.
* Leading cross-functional teams across multiple disciplines and geographies to understand and meet customer needs.
* Partnering with regional sales leadership to align territory strategies with SEL's strategic objectives.
* Managing sales efforts across multiple countries, complex territories, or geographically diverse regions.
* Leveraging CRM and other business tools to maintain customer information, track opportunities, and document sales activities.
* Fostering a culture of collaboration, high performance, and commitment to SEL values.

**This job might be for you if you have:**

* A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of progressively increasing responsibility in a technical sales environment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of electric power utility and/or critical process industry sales, customer service, and technical support.
* Knowledge of successful financial, business, and sales models.
* Proven experience managing complex regional sales efforts, territories, and teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills.
* The ability to learn and communicate the technical details of SEL solutions and competitive offerings.
* Strong writing, documentation, presentation, and communication skills.
* The ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

**Location**

We are open to filling this position in multiple locations. If you are an internal US employee located elsewhere, please don’t let location hinder you from applying.

**Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.**

People are at the core of our company and we hire employee-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees.

* We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options.
* We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
* We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay.
* We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs.
* Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits.

Pay Range Data

$100,000 - $193,900 per year. We set starting pay based on job-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly.

**Communication with Applicants**

We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com.

SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Job**

Georgia-Pacific Containerboard is seeking a Customer Account Manager to provide end-to-end support for domestic customer accounts. This role processes incoming orders, coordinates production demand, manages order fulfillment, and helps ensure customer delivery requirements are met. The Customer Account Manager serves as a primary customer contact and partners with sales representatives, manufacturing operations, transportation providers, third-party logistics providers, warehouses, and internal capability teams to develop service-focused and cost-effective solutions.

This position is based in Atlanta, Georgia, and follows a hybrid work schedule. Occasional after-hours availability may be required to support West Coast customers and resolve urgent shipment needs.

**What You Will Do**

* Entering a high volume of complex customer purchase orders with strong attention to detail, planning production timing, and tracking shipments through delivery.
* Building trusted customer relationships, understanding account needs and trends, and serving as the primary interface for supply chain support.
* Receiving and managing orders, changes, and cancellations; clarifying customer needs; and communicating updates, delays, and requests to customers and sales representatives.
* Resolving order fulfillment issues that arise during production, transportation, or warehouse storage.
* Coordinating product shipments, expediting urgent orders, and arranging pickup or return of defective product when needed.
* Partnering with sales and cross-functional teams, including operations, manufacturing, transportation, warehousing, and other capability groups, to implement service and cost solutions.
* Identifying root causes, evaluating service and cost tradeoffs, recommending practical solutions, and driving issues through resolution with urgency and sound economic thinking.
* Maintaining accurate customer pricing within GP's ERP system.
* Managing customer account credits and debits when issues arise.
* Monitoring and managing warehouse inventory levels to help ensure required products are available for shipment.
* Providing occasional after-hours support for urgent customer needs, including locating or tracking time-sensitive truck and rail shipments.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree and/or 5+ years relevant work experience
* Customer account management or supply chain experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including creating and modifying spreadsheets, using formulas, and analyzing or manipulating data
* Ability to manage competing priorities with strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to travel up to 10% for mill and customer visits

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* 2+ years of business experience
* Customer account management experience within a manufacturing environment
* Experience with order management, fulfillment, inventory, or enterprise resource planning systems
* Experience analyzing order, inventory, production, or shipment information to identify risks and recommend action
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across sales, manufacturing, transportation, and warehousing teams
* Adaptability and sound judgment when production, inventory, or transportation plans change
* Experience using Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Microsoft Copilot, to organize work, analyze information, communicate effectively, and improve productivity.

Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. **Hiring Philosophy**

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

**Who We Are**

As a Koch company and a leading manufacturer of bath tissue, paper towels, paper-based packaging, cellulose, specialty fibers, building products and much more, Georgia-Pacific works to meet evolving needs of customers worldwide with quality products. In addition to the products we make, we operate one of the largest recycling businesses. Our more than 30,000 employees in over 150 locations are empowered to innovate every day -to make everyday products even better.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. jobs.title: Client Service Manager - Private Client Marketing & Account Manager
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

The Private Client Marketing & Placement Specialist serves as a technical insurance expert responsible for designing, marketing, and placing complex personal insurance programs for affluent and high-net-worth clients. Working closely with producers, account managers, and carrier partners, this individual develops creative coverage solutions, negotiates with underwriters, and secures optimal terms for challenging and sophisticated risks.

This role operates behind the scenes but plays a critical part in delivering exceptional client outcomes through deep market knowledge, strategic carrier relationships, and technical expertise in personal insurance.

**In This Opportunity You Will Execute On:**

* Market and place new and renewal private client insurance accounts with premier carriers including Chubb, AIG, PURE, Cincinnati, Berkley One, and other specialty insurers.
* Analyze complex property, liability, and excess liability exposures to develop comprehensive insurance solutions.
* Negotiate coverage terms, pricing, and underwriting exceptions with carrier partners.
* Identify creative placement strategies for difficult-to-insure risks, including unique homes, secondary residences, coastal properties, wildfire exposures, collections, and specialty assets.
* Prepare and manage carrier submissions, applications, statements of values, and underwriting documentation.
* Collaborate with producers and service teams to develop customized insurance programs that align with client needs and risk profiles.
* Evaluate coverage differences and carrier appetites to recommend optimal solutions.
* Maintain strong relationships with carrier underwriting teams and stay current on market conditions, carrier capabilities, and emerging risks.
* Support proposal development and presentation materials for prospective and existing clients.
* Ensure accurate documentation and management of account activity within Applied Epic.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:**

* Deep understanding of high-net-worth personal insurance products and carrier offerings.
* Ability to think creatively and solve complex placement challenges.
* Confidence working directly with underwriters and advocating for clients.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple submissions and deadlines simultaneously.
* Natural curiosity and willingness to explore alternative solutions when standard markets decline coverage.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and provide thoughtful recommendations to internal stakeholders.

**In This Role You Will Need:**

* 5+ years of experience in personal insurance underwriting, private client marketing, or high-net-worth account management.
* Strong knowledge of private client carriers and their underwriting appetites.
* Experience marketing complex property and liability risks.
* Proficiency using Applied Epic or similar agency management systems.
* Professional designations such as CISR, CIC, CPRIA, or CPCU are preferred.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

We're looking for a seasoned insurance professional who enjoys solving complex placement challenges and leveraging carrier relationships to create best-in-class insurance programs with the ability to work part-time. This may be an experienced account manager, underwriter, or marketing specialist seeking a highly collaborative, non-client-facing role focused on strategy, placement, and technical excellence.

**Why Hylant?**

Since 1935, Hylant has been a family‑owned insurance brokerage built on relationships, trust, and a people‑first mindset. We believe great work is rooted in understanding people — our clients, our communities, and each other — and delivering thoughtful solutions that rise above the expected.

**Anything But Typical. Everything for You.** isn’t just a message; it’s how we show up. It reflects a culture where people come first, careers are supported with purpose, and going above and beyond is the standard, not the exception. At Hylant, you’re more than an employee, you’re part of a team that treats one another like family and works together to make a meaningful impact.

You will manage your own portfolio of customer accounts and be given ownership to build a work schedule that best suits you and your customers. You’ll make sales by maintaining customer relationships, demonstrating our latest tools on the spot, and providing high level customer consultation.

**What You'll do**
------------------

* Building relationships – you’ll meet with customers at a moment’s notice or be actively present to capture the perfect business opportunity. You understand to create value in account(s) through long-term, profitable relationships
* Time and Territory Management (TTM) - creating a daily schedule (including presence on jobsites and client offices) to optimize client potential and sales productivity by zone territory
* Be a Hilti Champion – you’ll carry the technical knowledge to present high level customer consultations in your defined territory and represent the Hilti brand in the marketplace
* Tracking your progress – you’ll utilize Salesforce to record all the interactions you had to make a sale as reporting is a key part of this role

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent work experience
* At least three years of outside sales experience – preferably in an environment with set targets
* Hands-on attitude – you'll be demonstrating our tools to our customers, using platforms such as Salesforce to keep track of everything, and collaborate with a variety of departments
* Maintain a valid driver’s license – we'll provide you with a company car, be sure you’re ready to drive
* Excellent time and territory management skills
* Must be able to walk on construction projects, climb scaffolding, and lift as much as 65 pounds at any given time
* Work a flexible and varied schedule

**What’s In It for You**
------------------------

We are committed to caring for our people, which is why our retention has been over 90% for the last five years. It’s why we haven’t gone through any waves of layoffs – even during the COVID-19 pandemic. We value development, which is why 80-90% of our roles are filled internally. It’s why most of our account managers come from a non-construction background.
  
Success at Hilti comes down to teamwork and ability – the Hilti culture is contagious, and we have an excellent mix of people who are always looking to help one another.
  
  
This job is #LI-Hybrid, meaning it is field-based and requires daily customer in-person interaction with your home serving as your office location.

**Why Hilti**
-------------

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion**
---------------------------

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

888VoIP is a premier value-added distributor of VoIP hardware, networking equipment, video conferencing solutions, and unified communications technology. We go beyond traditional distribution by offering white-glove provisioning, full logistics support, custom API integrations, flexible credit terms, and dedicated technical training to our channel partners.

We are expanding our presence in Texas and looking for a driven, high-performing Outside Sales Representative in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) metro area.

**Position Overview**

As an Outside Sales Representative for 888VoIP in the DFW market, you will drive revenue growth by establishing and expanding strategic partnerships with Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Telecom Resellers, Interconnects, and System Integrators.

You will act as a trusted advisor, educating channel partners on our comprehensive hardware ecosystem (IP phones, gateways, access points, headsets, and conference systems) and value-added logistics services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **New Partner Acquisition:** Prospect, identify, and recruit new MSPs, ITSPs, and telecom integrators across the DFW metroplex to buy hardware through 888VoIP's Reseller Channel Program.
* **Field Territory Management:** Conduct face-to-face meetings, product demonstrations, and site visits with prospective and existing accounts in the DFW region.
* **Relationship Management:** Build long-term relationships with MSP principals, vCIOs, purchasing managers, and technical leads to secure 888VoIP as their primary hardware distributor.
* **Consultative Selling:** Analyze partner product stacks and recommend tailored hardware solutions, provisioning services, and stocking strategies to streamline their operations.
* **Pipeline & Revenue Execution:** Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to onboarding, account growth, and recurring order management.
* **Industry Engagement:** Represent 888VoIP at regional channel events, MSP user groups, vendor roadshows, and trade shows across Texas.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with inside sales reps, technical support engineers, and vendor channel managers (Grandstream, Yealink, Poly, TP-Link/Omada, Netgear, Fanvil, etc.) to close opportunities.
* **CRM Maintenance:** Maintain accurate partner records, lead tracking, and pipeline forecasts within Salesforce/HubSpot.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–5+ years of B2B outside sales experience, specifically within the **telecom, VoIP, MSP, IT distribution, or SaaS infrastructure** space.
* **Local Network:** Strong existing network and familiarity with the DFW technology and MSP ecosystem.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Understanding of business telecommunications, SIP protocol, networking hardware, UCaaS platforms (e.g., 3CX, Microsoft Teams, Zoom Phone, Asterisk), and provisioning workflows.
* **Sales Track Record:** Proven history of meeting or exceeding quotas in a hunter/business development role.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills; comfortable presenting technical hardware solutions to business owners and technical buyers.
* **Mobility:** Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally across the DFW area (up to 80-95% field time).

The **Operations Coordinator** plays a critical role in supporting and executing delivery operations for healthcare clients within a fast-paced environment. This entry-level position is responsible for coordinating Independent Contractor (IC) couriers to ensure the timely and compliant transport of critical healthcare shipments. The coordinator ensures operational service excellence through communication, compliance oversight, and real-time problem-solving while adhering to healthcare industry standards such as HIPAA, FDA guidelines, and Good Distribution Practices (GDP). This position is ideal for someone detail-oriented, proactive, and committed to delivering service reliability in time-sensitive and regulated environments..

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following essential duties satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Individual tasks shall include but not be limited to the following:

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Monitor dispatch boards to ensure route coverage, completed driver check-ins, and on-time delivery of healthcare shipments, including STAT and temperature-sensitive deliveries, within required delivery windows.
* Coordinate route assignments and changes, communicate updates promptly to Dispatch and Independent Contractors (ICs), and reconcile route sheets with shipment paperwork to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Provide real-time support to ICs during active deliveries, troubleshoot service issues, and arrange backup STAT coverage as needed to maintain service continuity.
* Address and escalate delivery delays, service interruptions, missing freight, client concerns, and compliance issues promptly to management, clients, and other appropriate stakeholders.
* Reroute or personally execute deliveries as needed to address emergencies or critical service escalations.
* Receive, unpack, and inspect incoming shipments for accuracy, completeness, and damage.
* Pick and pack orders accurately and efficiently according to shipment requirements.
* Review inventory regularly to ensure stored assets are organized, accurately accounted for, and free from defects or damage.
* Inspect and document vehicle compliance with healthcare-specific requirements, including insulation, refrigeration, and required safety equipment.

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
#### **About Vibes**

At Vibes, we're redefining how enterprise brands connect with their customers through mobile. Vibes helps marketing, loyalty, and customer experience professionals at the world's most respected brands create personal, revenue-driving, and long-term mobile engagement between consumers and the brands they love. Industry leaders like Chipotle, Ulta, and Polo Ralph Lauren use Vibes to activate and grow customer relationships with timely, relevant, high-volume mobile messaging at a global scale.

Our intelligent mobile engagement platform enables marketers to seamlessly connect with their customers using a data-rich, API-packed platform that beautifully optimizes and unifies their SMS, MMS, RCS, and Mobile Wallet campaigns. Vibes has been recognized in 2026 as a Built In Best Hybrid Places to Work.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative who is equal parts operator, relationship builder, and student of the enterprise marketer. You’ll help build the AI-driven, automated outbound programs that create pipeline for our Platform sales team. You’ll also be the face of Vibes at the industry events where our buyers spend their time.

This is not a 100-dials-a-day role. You’ll use agentic workflows and automation to reach the right brands at scale. When an account deserves more than a sequence, you’ll write something only a person could write.

Events are where this role comes to life. You’ll travel to conferences and Vibes-hosted gatherings across the country. You’ll meet marketing, loyalty, and CX leaders from some of the most recognized consumer brands in the world, and turn a hallway conversation into a real relationship. The best version of this role is someone a brand leader remembers by name after a three-day conference, and is glad to hear from afterward.

You’ll report to our Director of Revenue Operations. That means close exposure to how Vibes builds its go-to-market systems, from HubSpot to AI agents. That makes this role a strong fit for someone who wants to grow toward a quota-carrying seat, or toward the operations and technology side of revenue.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and run automated, AI-driven outbound programs targeting enterprise brands in QSR, retail, and other consumer verticals, combining agentic workflows with targeted manual outreach.
* Write creative, one-to-one outreach for high-value accounts when the moment calls for it, whether that’s a sharp observation about their latest campaign, a personalized video, or a follow-up they’ll actually remember.
* Research target accounts and buyer personas so outreach reflects each brand’s marketing priorities, mobile maturity, and current messaging stack.
* Represent Vibes at conferences and events by working the floor, starting conversations, building genuine connections, and securing next steps.
* Plan your event strategy before you arrive, including who you want to meet, how you’ll get on their calendar, and how you’ll follow up so the conversation keeps going.
* Learn our story well enough to explain why SMS, MMS, RCS, and Mobile Wallet matter to a brand trying to win consumer mindshare.
* Hand off qualified opportunities to Account Executives with the context they need to move quickly.
* Keep HubSpot current and accurate; your activity, contacts, and meetings should be data the team can trust.
* Measure what’s working across campaigns and channels, and adjust based on results rather than instinct.
* Partner with Revenue Operations to test new tools, prompts, and automations, and share what you learn with the sales team.
* Consistently meet and exceed weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline goals.
* Travel to conferences and in-person events as needed, up to 50% of the time.

**Who You Are**

***An Operator, Not Just an Activity Machine***

* You’ve used AI and automation tools to do real prospecting work, and you can walk us through what you built and what it produced.
* You think in systems; when something works, your first instinct is to make it repeatable.
* You understand pipeline is the goal and automation is the means, and you hold yourself to the number.

***Curious, Creative, and a Little Quirky***

* You’re genuinely curious about people, and you ask the second and third question.
* You bring some personality to your work; people remember talking to you, and your messages don’t sound like everyone else’s.
* You can write the email that gets a reply when the template won’t, and you know when it’s worth the extra effort.
* You notice things about a brand, from a new loyalty launch to a clever text campaign, and use them to start a conversation.

***At Your Best in a Room Full of People***

* You look forward to walking into a conference, not just getting through it.
* You can approach someone you’ve never met, find common ground quickly, and tell whether there’s a real opportunity worth pursuing.
* You connect one on one; people walk away from a conversation with you feeling heard, not pitched.
* You follow up reliably, because a great conversation at an event only matters if it goes somewhere.

***Curious About the Marketer’s World***

* You want to understand how enterprise marketing and loyalty teams operate, including their pressures, their metrics, and the tools they juggle.
* You’re eager to learn mobile messaging, from high-volume SMS to RCS, and to connect it to outcomes a brand cares about.

***Coachable, Resilient, and Hungry***

* You’re self-directed and action-oriented; you don’t need external motivation to do excellent work.
* You take direct feedback well and can talk honestly about mistakes and what you learned from them.
* You stay positive and steady when a campaign underperforms or an event is slow.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* 1-2 years in sales development, business development, marketing operations, or RevOps, preferably in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI and automation tools for prospecting, research, or campaign

Novelis is one of the world leaders in aluminum recycling and rolling and a leading sustainable aluminum solutions provider. Driven by our purpose of shaping a sustainable world together, we work alongside our customers to provide innovative solutions to the aerospace, automotive, beverage packaging and specialty markets. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Novelis has approximately 13,000 employees in 32 operating facilities on 4 continents.

The Novelis Lincolnshire team is seeking an Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role is responsible for leading daily production activities, developing plant employees, and supporting operational excellence across the facility. The Operations Coordinator will partner with Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to achieve safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives while supporting continuous improvement and employee development initiatives.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with environmental, health, safety, and regulatory requirements, as well as company policies and procedures.
* Schedule, direct, and support employees in the completion of production activities to meet operational goals.
* Lead, coach, and develop employees to achieve production objectives while maintaining a safe and efficient work environment.
* Monitor material availability, inventory levels, and production requirements to support uninterrupted operations.
* Coordinate incoming material deliveries and support efficient material flow throughout the facility.
* Support First Line Leader (FLL) initiatives and projects that promote safety, employee development, continuous improvement, and business performance.
* Adjust work procedures and employee assignments to meet changing production schedules and operating priorities.
* Support workforce scheduling, overtime planning, and employee timekeeping activities using Kronos.
* Lead training activities related to new processes, equipment, and systems, including Kronos, SAP, and the Novelis Operating System (NOS).
* Ensure the Novelis Operating System is implemented and maintained according to established standards.
* Maintain accurate production records, reporting, and operational documentation.
* Communicate production requirements, work instructions, specifications, and operating expectations to employees.
* Monitor production output, quality, and operating performance and prepare reports for leadership review.
* Support furnace operations and process optimization efforts to improve recoveries and operating performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve production methods, equipment performance, product quality, and employee efficiency.
* Investigate operating issues, support root-cause problem solving, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Conduct employee meetings and reinforce compliance with safety, environmental, and operational requirements.
* Provide supervisory coverage on weekends, nights, holidays, and other periods as required.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering teams to support reliable people, processes, and equipment.
* Complete additional duties and projects as assigned.

--------------------------

* High school diploma or GED and two to three years of directly related supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and related leadership experience.
* Experience leading employees in a manufacturing, industrial, or production environment.
* Ability to read, interpret, and apply safety rules, operating procedures, technical instructions, and production documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees, leadership teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to analyze information, solve operational problems, and make sound business decisions.
* Experience developing, implementing, and managing operational processes and procedures.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
* Ability to work independently while leading teams toward operational and business objectives.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Valid driver's license.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Associate's degree or higher in manufacturing, business, engineering, operations management, or a related field.
* Experience using SAP, Kronos, or other manufacturing and workforce management systems.
* Experience with the Novelis Operating System or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience leading employee training and skills development programs.
* Experience supporting safety, quality, productivity, and cost improvement initiatives.
* Experience in aluminum manufacturing, metals production, or a related industrial environment.
* Experience working with production reporting, inventory management, and operational performance metrics.

**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.

Foster dialogue between scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and the public.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Coordinator supports the organized research activities and programming agendas of the France Berkeley Fund (FBF) and the Institute of European Studies (IES) in consultation with the directors of both organizations. This position supports outreach, communications, program development, and fundraising. To further the mission of both programs, the Program Coordinator promotes and supports research by UCB faculty and visiting researchers via the France Berkeley Fund and the IES Global Exchange programs.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Plans and develops new programs and adjusts existing programs in a research and public education environment.
  
Actively participates with faculty directors (FBF and IES) in long-range strategic planning for research and public educational programs. The FBF, Austrian Studies, Ctr. of French Excellence, Visiting Scholar, and URAP programs.

Participates in developing constituencies and promoting programs to target audiences.
  
Identifies and develops evaluation tools for programs.
  
Under general supervision, assists in implementing specific activities for specific fundraising programs and activities.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Working skills to produce and deliver programs.
  
Good reading, verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and good presentation skills.
  
Reading knowledge of basic French.
  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training

Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of departmental and organization policies and procedures and/or the ability to learn; knowledge of educational program content and objectives.
  
Working knowledge of delivering public educational programs.
  
Working knowledge of current public education programs and trends.
  
Working knowledge of conducting needs assessment.
  
Good analytical skills to understand how business needs can be addressed through the design and delivery of training programs.
  
Additional European Languages a plus.
  
  
Salary & Benefits
  
  
For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.
  
  
Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
==================

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
==================

**Own and grow your book**
--------------------------

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

**Find and close expansion with Customer Success**
--------------------------------------------------

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

**Show up in person and go beyond your champion**
-------------------------------------------------

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

**Run a clean commercial process**
----------------------------------

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

### **About the Role**

LiveX is a Google and NVIDIA ISV building AI-powered holographic displays for stadiums, retail, hotels, airports, and enterprises. The BDR drives top-of-funnel pipeline for the enterprise sales motion. Pure outbound: first point of contact for prospects, works curated target account lists, books meetings for the Head of GTM and senior sales team. The phone is the highest-converting channel, so the role requires enjoying cold calling. Strong performance leads to an AE or sales management path.

### **Responsibilities**

**Outbound Prospecting**

* Work curated target account lists (stadiums and sports venues, retail brands, hotels, airports, automotive, large events).
* Research event leaders, marketing executives, innovation leads, and operations decision-makers at each account.
* Run personalized multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
* Book qualified discovery meetings for the Head of GTM and senior AEs with clean handoff notes.

**Lead Enrichment and List Expansion**

* Add contacts at existing accounts (events leaders, CMOs, heads of fan/guest experience).
* Pull exhibitor and attendee lists from conferences (Google Cloud Next, NRF, HITEC, sports business conferences).
* Report which titles, verticals, and messaging convert.

**Pipeline Hygiene and CRM Discipline**

* Log every meaningful interaction in HubSpot; keep deal stages and lead statuses current; close lost after 4–5 unanswered follow-ups with a note.
* Maintain clean contact records, accurate next steps, visible task queues; update sequences and track reply rates.

**Event and Field Support**

* Attend trade shows and events to capture leads, scan badges, schedule on-site demos; follow up on event leads within 24 hours.

### **How to Approach the Work**

* Passion for outbound, especially cold calling; persistence (most enterprise deals close after the 6th–8th touch).
* Real-time CRM updates; proactive communication; ownership of weekly activity, conversion, and pipeline metrics.
* Balance manual list grinding with automated sequences/enrichment; bias toward action.

### **Requirements**

* 2–3 years of BDR/SDR experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, hardware, or enterprise sales.
* Demonstrated outbound experience (cold calling, cold emailing, building pipeline), not only inbound qualification.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding quota (meetings booked, opportunities created, pipeline generated).
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including with senior executives.
* Resilience and high energy; desire to grow toward AE or sales management.
* Curiosity about the product (holograms, AI, enterprise use cases).
* Tools: HubSpot (required; Salesforce acceptable); Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, Lusha, Clay; Outreach, Salesloft, Smartlead, Instantly; Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn, Loom; Google Sheets/Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP); Calendly, Chili Piper, HubSpot Meetings.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* AI tools for prospecting and personalization (Clay, ChatGPT, Claude, custom GPTs).
* List pulling via web scraping or basic automation.

### **Compensation and Growth**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on meetings booked and pipeline generated (no range listed).
* Equity; health, dental, and vision; direct mentorship from the Head of GTM and senior sales team; path to AE or sales management.
* Palo Alto office most days; some travel for trade shows and customer events.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Email career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Business Development Representative (BDR)", with a short note on why this role and why LiveX, your most impressive outbound metric with context, and your resume or LinkedIn.

Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. This is a key role for us as we expand, and you'll have the chance to be part of our growth journey from the ground up. As an BDR, you'll help fuel our pipeline, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the success of our Account Executives. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with us, with potential leadership opportunities, unlimited earning potential, and equity in the company.

About Aware Health

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. People with MSK conditions are often misdiagnosed and are treated passively with opioids, injections or surgery. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. Our platform gets people the right amount of help, avoiding inappropriate and unnecessary tests, drugs and surgeries. Our approach has resulted in positive outcomes for our members and has saved self-funded employers up to 59% annually in MSK costs.

About the Job

You'll be a key player in identifying, qualifying, and generating new business opportunities. Reporting to our SVP, Growth, you will be an integral part of our sales engine, contributing to the identification of potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting up meetings for our Account Executives. You'll be expected to drive top-of-funnel activity, helping to build relationships and create demand for our solution. We will invest in your growth, give you exposure to the full sales cycle with our SVP, Growth as a mentor, and ideally promote you into an AE role down the line.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment, is energized by sales challenges, and can adapt to changing needs. The right person will help us shape our outreach strategies, improve processes, and contribute to scaling our efforts. If you’re excited by early-stage growth and enjoy building something from the ground up, this is the role for you.

Metrics

Leading Indicators

* Leading Indicator: Activity
* Leading Indicator: Meetings booked per month
* Leading Indicator: Meeting to opportunity conversion rate

Outcomes:

* Number of sourced opportunities
* Closed/won revenue

Responsibilities

* Build our pipeline! Prospect and generate leads through cold calling, emails and social selling
* Be the first point of contact: Qualify inbound leads and set meetings for account executives
* Build and maintain relationships with innovative brokers, ecosystem partners and prospects
* Evangelize Aware Health’s value proposition, building demand for our solution
* Keep data updated in Hubspot CRM
* Strategically contribute to and drive the development of outreach strategies

* Partner with the Head of Growth to nurture and work deals from initial prospecting through close (we’re excited to train you up so you’ll be closing your own deals in this complicated industry over time!)

Why You’ll Love This Role

* Real-time access to executives who are invested in your growth
* A collaborative and fast-paced start up environment where your voice matters
* An impact-driven mission where you can feel great about the product you’re selling
* A clear career path to AE and beyond

Qualifications

--------------------

PolicyLift is the AI-native growth engine for independent P&C agencies: one platform that drives growth, consolidates fragments of point solutions, so agencies can source and close premium faster. Our team brings experiences from top-tier technology companies like Google, Meta, and Insurtech leaders like Qualia.  
  
PolicyLift is VC-backed, used by 1,000+ agents and actively services a book of over $1B in premium.

**About the Role**
------------------

You’re a former independent P&C agent who has quoted, bound, serviced and renewed policies. Now you'll draw on that experience to help build and implement technology that helps agents win more premium.

PolicyLift services a book of over $1B in premium, and we're adding agencies faster every month. This role is the person who helps get new agencies live, keeps their team unstuck, and brings the agent's point of view into what our team builds next. It's a hybrid of three things: product, onboarding, and ongoing agency success.

Customers listen to you because you've done their job. Our engineers listen to you for the same reason. You provide deep industry experience to solve real pain points at independent agencies.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

PolicyLift does four jobs for independent P&C agencies:

* **Grow.** Website, SEO, AI search and email marketing that bring in leads.
* **Intake.** AI agents, smart forms, and carrier data and documents, so every lead is captured and complete.
* **Submit.** One-click transfer to the systems that matter: AMS, CRM, raters and carriers.
* **Bind.** Comparisons and proposals that get the policy bound.

Every one of those touches the details agents care about: which carrier for which risk, what an HO-5 covers that an HO-3 doesn’t, how a BOP submission differs from a package. Agencies trust us with that work. The person who onboards them, trains their CSRs, and brings their feedback to our roadmap should speak their language fluently.

**What you'll do**

**Insurance Workflow Expertise**

**Onboarding and Implementation**

**Support**

* Be the first call when an agency hits something insurance-specific: a quote that doesn't look right, a carrier question, a workflow the AI should handle differently.
* Reproduce, document and triage issues before escalating to engineering, then follow them through to resolution.
* Help drive adoption early (low usage, reverted workflows, a CSR who went back to the old way) and fix the root cause: retraining, a workflow change, or a product request.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A former (or current) agent.** You hold or recently held a P&C license, and you've spent 3+ years in an independent agency as a producer, or account manager
* **Fluent in personal and commercial lines.** You can explain HO-3 vs. HO-5, when an umbrella makes sense, BOP vs. package, GL class codes, experience mods and commercial auto symbols without looking them up.
* **Hands-on with agency tech.** You've lived inside an AMS, run comparative raters, worked carrier portals and download feeds.

* **Bilingual: insurance agent and product specialist.** You can earn an agency owner's trust in the morning and walk an engineer through an edge case in the afternoon.
* **Curious about AI.** You don't need to write code. You do need to want to understand how the product works and help it get better.

**Bonus qualifications**
------------------------

* You've led an AMS or rater migration or implementation.
* You've tried AI tools in your agency and know where they fall short.
* Any product or tech-adjacent experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* An opportunity to bring your insurance expertise into a leading AI platform for insurance.

**GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB**

Reporting directly to the General Services Director, this position supports developing, managing, and coordinating capital improvement projects, including planning, organizing, bidding and construction administration, and project execution. Monitors capital budgets to ensure project costs stay within the scope of work. Provides administrative support, project coordination, and financial oversight for all aspects of capital construction projects. Assist with preparing construction specifications, bid documents, contracts, and change orders. Enters approved payment applications into the city’s ERP system. Completes field inspection reports and inputs and updates data, documentation, and budget information into the CIP project management platform (Procore).

**SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Functions:

Coordinates and prepares facility services and construction specifications, and bid documents. Coordinates pre-bid and pre-construction conferences. Drafts Request for Proposals (RFP) and develop the scope of work.

Coordinates the design and permit process and work of contractors, engineers, architects, design professionals, and other personnel to ensure the efficient and economical use of program funds, personnel, materials, facilities, and time.

Monitors individual project budget summaries assuring expenditures are within approved budget, tracking changes to the contract documents that may result in change orders. Assists with project financial reports, accounting, and grant reimbursement. Prepares project budgets and assists with budget development, as requested by the director. Monitors and ensures all requirements of grants and contracts are met. Prepares complete reports on time with supporting conclusions and recommendations.

Develops and maintains data systems and records to track the progress of each project for proper evaluation, control, and documentation to ensure compliance with City, State, and Federal requirements.

Assures effective communication among consultants, contractors, department heads, and other stakeholders. Communicates project status to staff and other affected groups, keeping building occupants informed as to the progress of projects and of any developing problems, reporting alternative courses of action to mitigate such problems.

Creates presentation materials, authors' written and oral reports, and media materials. Uses speaking engagements, media interviews, and other methods to enhance the community’s awareness of and appreciation for capital projects and to educate community stakeholders regarding each project’s function and objectives.

Coordinates design, specification, and construction meetings.

Performs other related work as required by the director.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND TRAINING**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, architecture, construction management, construction administration, or a related field, supplemented by three (3) years of experience with project coordination, business operations, or administrative management.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience which provides the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities for this job will also be considered.

Requires a valid state driver’s license with an acceptable driving history.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS REQUIRED**

Physical Requirements:

This position classifies the physical exertion requirements has the ability to exert very moderate physical effort in light work, typically involving some combination of stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, and which may involve some lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 30 pounds). Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discriminate colors or shades of colors, sounds, odor, depth, and visual cues or signals. Some tasks require the ability to communicate orally. Performance of essential functions may require exposure to adverse environmental conditions, such as odors, fumes, temperature and noise extremes, machinery, vibrations, electric currents, traffic hazards, or bright/dim lights.

Account Manager

Reports to: VP, Strategic Accounts

I. Role Summary

The Account Manager supports the management, retention, and growth of Pharma Strategies' client and PBM relationships. This role is responsible for day-to-day account coordination, partner communication, onboarding support with enrollment, program reporting, and follow-up activities that help clients successfully adopt and expand the Enhanced Care Management Program (ECMP).

Working under the direction of the VP of Strategic Accounts, the Account Manager helps maintain strong client relationships by responding to routine requests, coordinating internal resources and pharmacy partner, monitoring account activity, disseminating weekly reports, and ensuring that commitments and next steps are completed on time.

This role collaborates closely with the Care Coordinator Team, Strategic Accounts including PBM partners and Pharmacy partners, Client Operations, Technical Operations, and Business Development to support successful partner implementation, ongoing program adoption, and account growth.

II. Primary Responsibilities

Account Coordination and Support

* Support the VP of Strategic Accounts in managing relationships with PBMs, employer groups, and other client partners, including network pharmacies.
* Serve as a market-facing ambassador for ECMP and Pharma Strategies’ mission, representing the company with professionalism and communicating the program’s value to clients and partners.
* Serve as a day-to-day contact for routine client questions, requests, and follow-up activities.
* Coordinate client meetings, prepare agendas, support Director of Patient Onboarding for weekly touchpoint calls. Document meeting notes and distribute action items.
* Track account commitments, deadlines, open issues, and next steps.
* Escalate strategic, technical, or operational opportunities to the appropriate leader.

Client and PBM Retention

* Help monitor the health, satisfaction, and engagement of assigned accounts.
* Maintain and initiate regular communication with client contacts and respond to requests in a timely, professional manner.
* Track enrollment performance and other assess account risks.
* Gather client feedback and share relevant insights with internal teams.

Program Adoption and Growth

* Monitor ECMP adoption, enrollment, and engagement across assigned accounts.
* Prepare routine account updates, enrollment reports, and performance summaries
* Identify participation trends, gaps, and potential opportunities for increased adoption. Monitor members through the ECMP patient journey.
* Coordinate outreach and follow-up activities that support employer-group enrollment and engagement.
* Share observations and potential growth opportunities with the VP of Strategic Accounts.

Reporting and Documentation

* Maintain accurate and current client records, contact information, meeting notes, action items, and account plans.
* Assist with recurring client reports, presentation materials, and internal account reviews, including Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Maintain organized documentation in approved company systems.
* Handle client and program information in accordance with applicable privacy, security, and confidentiality requirements.

SOP and Process Support

* Follow established standard operating procedures for partner onboarding, account management, and group expansion.
* Support consistent execution of account management workflows as the organization grows.
* Support the VP of Strategic Accounts in developing, updating, and refining policies, procedures, and workflows by contributing input and assisting with documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

* VP, Strategic Accounts to execute account strategies, support client relationships, and coordinate growth initiatives.
* Client Operations to ensure services are delivered in alignment with partner expectations.
* Technical Operations to document, track, and resolve system or reporting needs.
* Care Coordinator Team to coordinate client-related service needs and resolve routine issues.

IV. Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, communications, marketing, or a related field preferred.
* One to three years of experience in account management, customer success, client services, project coordination, healthcare, pharmacy benefits, or a related area.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and follow-up items.
* Ability to build professional relationships with clients and cross-functional colleagues.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools.
* Experience with CRM, project-management, or client-reporting systems is preferred.
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy benefits, employer-sponsored health programs, or population health is preferred. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and safeguard patient information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and company standards.

V. Core Competencies

* Client service: Responds professionally, follows through on commitments, and helps create a positive partner experience.
* Organization: Maintains accurate records and effectively manages timelines, tasks, and competing priorities.
* Communication: Presents information clearly and adapts communication to internal and external audiences.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across departments to support shared client objectives.
* Problem-solving: Identifies issues, gathers relevant information, and escalates concerns appropriately.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and completes work accurately and on time.
* Learning agility: Quickly develops knowledge of the ECMP, pharmacy benefits, account-management practices, and company processes.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Key job responsibilities  
Contributing to, and leading, within an AWS customer account team.  
  
Identifying and building trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, specifically CxOs at the customer, across Line of Business (LoB), Functional (R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain), and Digital & IT.  
  
Working closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to support the best business solution(s) for customers.  
  
Defining a CXO relationship strategy within the customer, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction levels.

Working with marketing and communications to develop formal references, PR and case studies highlighting impactful customer activity and workloads running on AWS.

* Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team.
